title: AI Red Team Tester
description:
**About The Role**
 If you've ever looked at a system and immediately started thinking about how to break it — this role was made for you. We're looking for security\-minded professionals to stress\-test AI systems, expose their weaknesses, and help build the next generation of safe, reliable AI.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your findings directly shape how AI behaves in the real world.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design and execute red\-teaming exercises to uncover security weaknesses in AI systems
* Craft adversarial prompts and edge\-case scenarios to probe model guardrails and safety filters
* Evaluate AI outputs for unsafe behavior, bias, and policy violations
* Document vulnerabilities, exploits, and unexpected behaviors in clear, structured reports
* Collaborate with engineering teams to recommend practical mitigations and improvements
* Stay current on emerging AI security threats, jailbreak techniques, and adversarial research
* Help define and refine security evaluation rubrics and testing protocols


**Who You Are**
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts — threat modeling, penetration testing, or ethical hacking
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML systems, large language models, or prompt engineering
* Creative and analytical — you enjoy finding the edge cases others miss
* Excellent written communication and documentation skills
* Comfortable working independently in an asynchronous, task\-based environment
* Familiarity with open\-source AI platforms or LLM ecosystems is a plus
* Background in infosec, AI safety research, or adversarial ML is a bonus — but not required


**Why Join Us**
* Work at the cutting edge of AI security alongside top research labs
* See your work directly improve the safety of AI products used by millions of people
* Full autonomy and a flexible schedule — work when and how you work best
* Build deep, marketable expertise in one of the fastest\-growing fields in tech
* Ongoing contract potential with opportunities to expand scope and responsibility
* Be part of a global community of experts shaping the future of responsible AI

title: Offensive Security Analyst (Structured / Non-Exploit)
description:

 What if your ability to think like an adversary could directly shape how AI understands and reasons about cybersecurity threats? We're looking for Offensive Security Analysts to analyze real\-world attack paths, model adversary behavior, and help build the AI systems that will define the future of security.
   

  

 This role is focused on
 **structured adversarial reasoning** 
 — not exploit development. You'll bring your red team instincts and attack knowledge to a unique challenge: teaching AI how threats actually unfold, where defenses break down, and how risk cascades through modern environments.
   

  

 Fully remote, flexible hours, and meaningful work at the frontier of AI.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Analyze attack paths, kill chains, and adversary strategies across realistic, production\-like environments
* Identify weaknesses, misconfigurations, and defensive gaps in complex system architectures
* Review and evaluate red team scenarios, intrusion narratives, and threat models
* Generate, label, and validate adversarial reasoning data used to train and benchmark AI systems
* Articulate attack chains, impact assessments, and risk tradeoffs in clear, structured formats

* Background in cloud security, network architecture, or enterprise environments
* Prior work in security research, CTF competitions, or technical writing
* Exposure to AI tools or data labeling workflows


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly on frontier AI systems alongside the world's leading AI research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — structure your work around your life, not the other way around
* Freelance autonomy with the substance of meaningful, high\-impact projects
* Apply your offensive security expertise in a novel, intellectually engaging context
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Security Engineer
description:
**Security Engineer (VAPT and Remediation)** 




**Location:** 
 Pune (Hybrid)
 



**Experience:** 
 5\+ years
 



**Availability: 0\-15 days** 




  





 About the role
 



 This is a hands\-on security engineering role that owns the full cycle: find the vulnerability, prove it, fix it, and confirm it stays fixed. You will run penetration tests and security reviews across our applications and infrastructure, then remediate what you find, in application code or in configuration, whatever the fix requires.
 



  





 What you will do
 



 Security Analysis and Testing
 


* Plan and execute penetration tests on web applications, APIs, mobile apps (iOS and Android), thick clients, and supporting infrastructure.
* Review application and infrastructure security design: authentication and authorization, session handling, data flows, secrets management, network exposure, and cloud configuration.
* Find what scanners miss through manual testing: business logic flaws, chained vulnerabilities, and privilege escalation paths.
* Run and tune vulnerability scans across applications, hosts, and cloud accounts.
* Triage, deduplicate, and prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact alongside CVSS.
* Track remediation to closure and maintain an accurate view of open risk.
* Retest fixes and close findings only when the vulnerability is confirmed resolved.



 Remediation and patching
 


* Fix vulnerabilities directly in application code, in whatever language or framework the application uses.
* Fix infrastructure and configuration issues: web server and TLS settings, cloud IAM and network rules, container and Kubernetes configuration, infrastructure\-as\-code, and CI/CD pipeline hardening.
* Apply patches and upgrades to operating systems, frameworks, libraries, and third\-party components, and verify the exposure is closed.
* Where code or infrastructure is owned by another team, raise the change yourself as a pull request or configuration change and drive it to merge.



 Reporting and communication
 


* Write clear findings with reproduction steps, evidence, risk rating, and specific remediation guidance.
* Explain risk to developers, DevOps engineers, and non\-technical stakeholders, and agree on realistic remediation timelines.



 What you bring
 



 Experience
 


* 5\+ years in penetration testing, application security, or security engineering, with a track record of fixing the vulnerabilities you report.



 Deep VAPT expertise
 


* Web: manual testing with Burp Suite Professional; OWASP Top 10 and ASVS; injection, authentication and session flaws, access control (IDOR/BOLA), SSRF, deserialization, XXE, race conditions, and business logic abuse.
* API: REST, GraphQL, SOAP, and gRPC; OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT weaknesses; mass assignment, rate limiting, and object\-level authorization failures.
* Mobile (iOS and Android): static and dynamic analysis against OWASP MASVS/MASTG; Frida, Objection, MobSF, jadx, and Ghidra or Hopper; SSL pinning and root/jailbreak detection bypass; insecure storage, IPC, and deep link issues.
* Thick client: interception of non\-HTTP protocols, reverse engineering of .NET, Java, and native binaries, memory and local storage analysis, DLL hijacking, and client\-side trust issues.
* Infrastructure: network and host testing with Nmap, Nessus, and Metasploit; Active Directory fundamentals; Linux and Windows hardening.



 Remediation skills
 


* Able to read and modify code in multiple languages. Expect a mix that may include Java, C\#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Go, Swift, and Kotlin. Depth in at least two of these, and the ability to land a correct, tested fix in an unfamiliar codebase.
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate testing and remediation.
* Practical experience with Git\-based workflows, pull requests, and code review.
* Working knowledge of Nginx, Apache, IIS, TLS configuration, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure\-as\-code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.



 Working knowledge (fundamentals level)
 


* Cloud security: IAM, networking, storage, logging, and encryption across AWS, Azure, and GCP; CIS benchmarks; CSPM and cloud audit tooling such as Prowler.
* Vulnerability assessment: enterprise scanners, CVSS, and patch management processes.
* SOC operations: SIEM concepts, log analysis, incident response fundamentals, and MITRE ATT\&CK; able to support incident triage with attacker\-perspective input and feed detection ideas back from test findings.



 Communication
 


* Clear written reports and the ability to explain risk and trade\-offs to engineers and business stakeholders.



 Nice to have
 


* Public security research, CVEs, bug bounty findings, or CTF experience.
* Experience integrating SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling such as Aikido into CI/CD pipelines.
* Threat modeling and secure design review experience.
* Familiarity with compliance evidence requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS) as they relate to vulnerability remediation.



 What success looks like
 


* Findings from your tests reach confirmed, retested fixes within agreed timelines.
* Development and DevOps teams see you as someone who fixes problems alongside them.
* Recurring vulnerability classes decline over time because fixes address root causes.
* Cloud misconfiguration and patch exposure windows stay short.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations*** Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation*** Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support*** Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance*** Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.

* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.

* Protect company assets and customer property.

* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.

Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**

  


The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose:**

  


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**

  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**

  

**Education**:

* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**

  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

**Key Performance Indicators:**

  

**KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency

  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**

  


When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths**across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist & HR Generalist (Animal Shelter)
description:
**This position is NOT for everyone.**

Sarvoham is looking for a **Talent Acquisition Specialist \& HR Generalist** **who genuinely believes in compassion, animal welfare, animal rights, and responsible people relationships.**

This is **not a desk\-only role**. Our **People \& Culture** team must understand the realities of working in an animal shelter and be willing to step onto the ground whenever required pro\-actively.

**We are looking for someone who:**

● Is **vegan or open to transitioning to veganism**, and genuinely understands the ethical principles behind welfare of the animals.

● Genuinely cares about **all animals and all species**, not only dogs, and believes animals deserve **compassion, dignity, freedom from cruelty, and protection from exploitation**.

● Is willing to **actively advocate for animal rights and welfare**, both within and outside the organization.

● Is willing to be **hands\-on with shelter operations** and participate in or support activities such as **animal rescues, animal handling, bathing, feeding, walking, cleaning kennels, maintaining hygiene, enrichment, transportation, and basic shelter upkeep**.

● Is willing to work alongside **animal caretakers, rescuers, veterinarians, volunteers, and frontline teams**, and understands and respects the challenges they face.

● Can respond calmly and responsibly during **animal emergencies, rescue situations, difficult cases, injuries, conflicts, and other high\-pressure shelter situations**.

● Is willing to understand the complete animal\-care cycle, from **rescue and admission to treatment, rehabilitation, enrichment, adoption, foster care, and end\-of\-life care where necessary**.

● Believes employees working in animal welfare deserve **empathy, dignity, fairness, psychological safety, accountability, and strong leadership**, while being capable of holding people accountable without losing compassion and humanity.

● Is willing to **lead by example** rather than expect others to do work they are unwilling to do themselves.

● Understands that working for an animal welfare organization is fundamentally different from working in a conventional corporate environment.

**Please DO NOT apply if:**

* **You are not compassionate towards animals, care only about dogs, are unwilling to support ground\-level shelter operations, or are uncomfortable with cleaning, handling, feeding, walking, bathing, rescuing, or caring for animals when required.**
* **Please also do not apply if you believe Talent Acquisition Specialist \& HR Generalist should remain completely separate from shelter operations, are unwilling to stand up against animal cruelty and advocate for animal rights, or are looking only for a conventional corporate role.**
* At Sarvoham Animal Foundation, **Talent Acquisition Specialist \& HR Generalist** is not simply about Human Resources, Talent Acquisition and employee relations.
* It is about **building a culture around a shared purpose: creating a kinder world for animals while building an organization where the people serving that mission can thrive.**
* We would rather hire **one deeply aligned person who is willing to learn, get their hands dirty, stand up for animals, and lead with compassion** than someone with an impressive résumé who does not believe in our mission.
* **If this resonates with you, please read the complete JD carefully before applying.**
* **If it does not, we respectfully request that you do not apply.**

**Position**: Talent Acquisition Specialist \& HR Generalist

**Department:** Human Resources

**Location:** Bangalore, India (On\-site)

**Reporting To:** People \& Culture Manager

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Sarvoham is a charitable organization dedicated to the welfare of under\-privileged animals in Bangalore, India. Sarvoham was established in April 2017 by co\-founders Haris Ali \& Madhusmita Sahu with a vision to create an inclusive eco\-system that co\-exists with animals providing them a respectable life that contributes to the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) frameworks and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs’) for the planet.

Over the past 9 years, Sarvoham has grown from a small charity effort to a well\-established animal welfare organization. We have rescued more than 3500 street animals, and provide a shelter for more than 200 dogs.

Sarvoham means the harmony between all elements of nature, both human and non\-human, and the organization is guided by the spirit of harmonious coexistence.

**ROLE PURPOSE:**

Sarvoham stands at a defining moment in its journey to create a more compassionate world for animals and seeks to expand its impact by building a sustainable ecosystem of partnerships and philanthropy that will enable many more lives to be saved and transformed.

We are looking for compassionate and organized freshers who are passionate about people practices while ensuring that our culture remains aligned with our mission and values. This is a pivotal role responsible for building the organization's all\-round people practices that translate into an ecosystem of partnerships, influence, and trust. This role requires an incumbent who can balance empathy with high levels of ownership and accountability through excellence in employee experience and wellbeing that is sustainable in the long\-term while also addressing the required evolution.

**WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS:**

* **Building Sarvoham as a purpose driven employer of choice for Talent:** Sarvoham has built a reliable and credible rescue and rehabilitation model since 2017\. The Foundation is looking for an experienced member as the Talent Acquisition Specialist \& HR Generalist to attract, engage, build sustainable and meaningful relationships with individuals who resonate with the Foundation’s purpose to build a society that provides a ‘respectable’ life to all animal species.
* **Build a Talent community with a Stewardship mindset:** Working closely with the CEO, Board, leadership team and civil society organizations, the incumbent will cultivate meaningful relationships that generate talent in the form of full\-time employees and volunteers who inspire collective action and expand the Foundation's impact across India.
* **Design the People, Culture and Talent Community:** Work closely with the leadership team at Sarvoham to design, implement and lead the talent attraction and retention strategy at Sarvoham that can attract desired talent across technical and functional requirements with a sense of purpose and commitment to contribute positively to perpetuity of Sarvoham's veterinary and sanctuary missions.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**End to End Talent Acquisition (50%):** Spearhead end to end talent acquisition across roles for the foundation including but not limited to:

Veterinary professionals, Animal caregivers, Shelter and sanctuary staff, Field rescue teams, Fundraising professionals, Communications and Marketing roles, Finance, Human Resources and Administration in addition to Leadership and Specialist positions

***Responsibilities:***

* Partner with the leadership team at Sarvoham to project manpower requirements.
* Design job descriptions and recruitment campaigns.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, social media, referrals, universities and professional networks.
* Build available talent pipelines that align with the vision, mission and purpose of Sarvoham for critical positions.
* Screen resumes and conduct competency and skills assessments including initial interviews.
* Conduct reference and background checks for shortlisted candidates.
* Own the candidate engagement and communication engagement throughout the recruitment process.
* Prepare letters of intent, letters post compensation and fitment assessment within approved guidelines.
* Ensure an exceptional candidate experience from recruitment and onboarding to across the employee life\-cycle.

**HR Generalist (50%):** Partner with the leadership team at Sarvoham to support the employee life\-cycle including but not limited to the following:

***Responsibilities:***

* Coordinate pre\-joining formalities, conduct induction programmes, facilitate new employee orientation and ensure smooth integration into teams.
* Maintain employee records, support HRIS updates, coordinate probation to confirmations, maintain HR dashboards and reports.
* Organise meaningful employee engagement initiatives including learning and development.
* Performance Management aligned with policies.
* Support wellness and recognition programmes.
* Support implementation of HR policies and compliance with regulations.
* Address employee queries and grievances, initiating corrective and disciplinary measures as required.
* Partner on Strategic Projects at Sarvoham including volunteering for animal welfare activities and programs.

**SUCCESS MEASURES:**

**Community Engagement \& Social Impact:**

Build partnerships with agencies and groups for building a network of veterinarians’ , NGOs, and volunteers that empower communities to become active participants in animal welfare, environmental sustainability, and community resilience.

**Candidate \& Employee NPS:**

Build credibility for Sarvoham as an employer of choice with a vision that resonates and attracts employee acquisition, sustainable retention and development to become active participants in animal welfare, environmental sustainability, and community resilience.

**Candidate \& Employee Experience:**

Build credibility for Sarvoham as an employer of choice with a vision that resonates and attracts employee acquisition, sustainable retention and development to become active participants in animal welfare, environmental sustainability, and community resilience.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE:**

The ideal candidate is a purpose\-driven individual who combines strategic thinking with a blend of compassion, influence, and execution, engaging prospective employees and communities, while inspiring internal teams around a shared purpose.

* **Work Experience:** 0\-2 years of progressive experience in talent acquisition and employee life\-cycle management. Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* **Proven Track Record:** of fulfillment and employee satisfaction.
* **Operational Skills:** Proven ability to recruit and design, people thinking policies and processes with psychometric assessments, assignments and data\-driven management.

**PREFERRED BACKGROUNDS:**

* Understands brand building.
* Ability to become a preferred partner for candidates and employees.
* 0–2 years of HR experience.
* Experience in NGOs, healthcare, veterinary services, social impact organizations as a volunteer or employee.
* Practices and promotes a life\-style that is animal friendly.

**WHY JOIN SARVOHAM:**

We are on a mission to establish equity, inclusion, and compassion for animals in society, so that they can lead a fulfilling and respectable life. We are looking for a clinician who resonates with this mission and believes that their experience, skills, and judgment can genuinely change outcomes for the animals who need it most — leading by example, and helping build a people practice that will sustain for generations to come.

Pay: Up to ₹400,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* At Sarvoham we do not encourage the use of AI for any communication. Please confirm that you have not used AI or paraphrasing tools. We only consider authentic responses to these questions.
* Have you ever personally rescued or helped an injured, abandoned, or distressed animal? Please describe.
* Are you comfortable working in an environment with rescued animals, including those that are sick, injured, disabled, or terminally ill? Please explain.
* When would you be available to join Sarvoham if selected?
* Do you currently follow a vegetarian or vegan lifestyle? If no, are you willing to transition?
* Are you willing to actively advocate for veganism as part of Sarvoham's mission?
* How do you believe you can contribute to Sarvoham? Please be specific in reference to your skills.
* Briefly describe your experience managing the complete People \& Culture function for an organization.
* As a People \& Culture manager, would you hire a candidate who consumes meat as a personal choice for an animal\-welfare organization? Please explain
* What do you know about Sarvoham? Why do you want to work for an animal welfare organization like Sarvoham? Please share in your own words.

entry level position who can provide support to the sourcing function. Collects suppliers’ quotations and examines bids. Identifies and selects suppliers that meet the organization’s standards of price, quality, and delivery.

To understand the Customers product requirements and source non\-catalog products from Market Source suppliers for customers based on product codes, descriptions and applications required.

* Use product knowledge, to find new cross\-references based on provided data (competitor information, descriptions, manufacturer part numbers)
* Review and validate cross\-references provided by the system

description:
**COMPLIANCE EXECUTIVE – PMS**

Location: Satellite, Ahmedabad

Qualification: Qualified Company Secretary (CS)

Experience: Fresher / 0–1 year

**ABOUT THE ROLE** 

We are looking for a qualified Company Secretary (CS) fresher to join our Compliance team as a Compliance Executive – PMS . The role will primarily focus on regulatory and compliance activities relating to our SEBI\-registered Portfolio Management Services (PMS) business . The candidate will work closely under the Compliance Officer and will receive hands\-on exposure to SEBI regulations, regulatory filings, audits, internal controls and the day\-to\-day compliance framework of an investment management business. While compliance will be the primary responsibility , the role will also work closely with the Operations and Accounts teams. In a PMS, regulatory compliance is closely connected with transactions, client accounts, reconciliations, reporting and financial records. The candidate will therefore be expected to understand and support these functions wherever required to ensure that compliance data, reporting and outcomes are accurate, complete and timely .

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. PMS \& Regulatory Compliance** 

● Assist the Compliance Officer in ensuring compliance with applicable SEBI Portfolio Managers Regulations, circulars, guidelines and other regulatory requirements . ● Track regulatory requirements, compliance calendars, filing dates and internal deadlines. ● Assist in preparing and submitting periodic regulatory filings, reports and disclosures. ● Monitor SEBI circulars and regulatory developments and assist in identifying their applicability to the firm. ● Maintain appropriate supporting records and documentation for regulatory compliance. ● Assist in implementation and monitoring of internal compliance policies, processes and controls.

**2\. Compliance Monitoring \& Documentation** 

● Maintain compliance trackers, registers, checklists and supporting documentation. ● Perform periodic checks to ensure prescribed processes and internal controls are being followed. ● Assist in reviewing client documentation, agreements, disclosures and other compliance\-related records. ● Follow up with relevant teams for information and documents required for compliance. ● Ensure regulatory and compliance records are properly maintained and readily retrievable.

**3\. Audit \& Regulatory Support** 

● Assist with internal audits, statutory audits, compliance audits and regulatory inspections . ● Compile and cross\-check information required by auditors, regulators and other external agencies. ● Coordinate internally to obtain supporting documents and ensure timely closure of audit observations. ● Maintain proper records of audit queries, responses, observations and corrective actions.

**4\. Operations \& Accounting Coordination**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Position: Senior Accounts Executive

CA Location: Ahmedabad

Employment Type: Full\-time

Reports to: Group Head Accountant

ROLE SUMMARY

We are looking for a Chartered Accountant to join our Accounts team and work closely with the Group Head Accountant across accounting, taxation, financial reporting and MIS for the Capital 8 Group. As a Portfolio Management Services (PMS) business, the role will also include selected PMS operational responsibilities that are closely connected with accounts, reconciliations and financial reporting. The candidate will be trained on these processes as part of the role. This is a hands\-on role suited to a CA who is quick, accurate, detail\-oriented and takes pride in producing complete and correct work on time.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. Accounts \& Finance** 

● Support the Group Head Accountant in maintaining complete and accurate books of accounts across group entities. ● Accounting and review of entries in Tally , including ledgers, journals, expenses, income, investments and banking transactions. ● Prepare and review bank, ledger and other financial reconciliations . ● Assist with monthly, quarterly and annual closing of accounts. ● Support preparation of financial statements, schedules and MIS reports . ● Handle and review GST, TDS and other applicable tax compliances , including calculations, reconciliations and filings. ● Assist in preparation of data, workings and documentation for statutory audit, tax audit and other audits . ● Coordinate with auditors, consultants, banks and other external parties as required. ● Maintain proper supporting documents, workings and accounting records so that books remain complete and audit\-ready . ● Prepare and review Excel\-based workings, reconciliations and management reports. ● Identify accounting discrepancies, missing information or incorrect entries and proactively work towards resolving them. ● Support the Group Head Accountant across other accounting, finance and treasury responsibilities as required.

**2\*.** PMS Operations \& Reconciliation\*

As part of the Accounts team, the candidate will also support operational processes of our Portfolio Management Services (PMS) business that directly interact with accounting and financial reporting. ● Learn and understand the basic trade lifecycle — execution, settlement, custody, banking, accounting and reporting . ● Assist with day\-to\-day PMS operational processes and related accounting entries. ● Reconcile data between internal records, bank accounts, custodian records and Fund Accountant/PMS reports. ● Cross\-check transactions, holdings, cash balances, fees and other financial data across different systems and records. ● Support trade settlement, reconciliation and other operational processes as assigned. ● Carefully verify operational data before it flows into accounting and investor reporting. ● Coordinate with Accounts, Operations and other internal teams to resolve differences or missing information. ● Understand how errors in transactions or operations can flow into accounts, reporting and compliance , and ensure operational work is handled with the same care and accuracy as accounting work. No prior PMS experience is required. The candidate will learn these processes on the job and develop an understanding of how PMS Operations and Accounts work together.

**REQUIRED SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES**

● Chartered Accountant (CA) — freshers are welcome. ● Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals, taxation, GST and TDS. ● Strong Excel skills and familiarity with Tally or similar accounting software. ● Strong numerical ability and attention to detail. ● Ability and willingness to cross\-check and independently verify numbers , rather than relying entirely on system outputs. ● Quick learner, comfortable learning PMS accounting and operational processes on the job. ● Good written and verbal communication skills.

**WHAT WE LOOK FOR You will do well in this role if you:**

● Like your numbers to tally perfectly and take pride in accurate, complete work. ● Notice when something doesn't look right and investigate it rather than letting it pass. ● Are organised, disciplined and take deadlines seriously. ● Prefer completing work correctly the first time rather than fixing errors later. ● Take ownership of your work and are comfortable being accountable for its accuracy and completeness. ● Keep your workings, files and supporting documents organised and audit\-ready. ● Enjoy working in a high\-accountability, high\-productivity environment . ● Want to learn, grow and gradually take on greater independent responsibility across Group Accounts and PMS processes.

title: Technical Trainer
description:
Job Description: **Robotics Trainner**

**Job post summary**

**Location:** Bangalore (In\-person)  
**Office Base:** Banashankari, Bangalore  
**Travel Requirement:** Travel to partner schools across Bangalore

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent  
**Schedule:** Day Shift (Monday to Saturday)

**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹30,000 per month (based on experience)  
*(Freshers may start from ₹12,000 – ₹18,000 with training provided)*

**About the Role**

We are looking for passionate and enthusiastic **Robotics, AI \& STEM Trainers / STEM Teachers** to deliver engaging, hands\-on learning experiences for school students from **Grades 1 to 10**.

The role involves teaching and facilitating practical learning across **Robotics, Electronics, Coding, Artificial Intelligence, Python, AI\-assisted/vibe coding, 3D Printing, and emerging technologies**.

The trainer will travel to different partner schools across Bangalore to conduct STEM sessions, implement curriculum, guide student projects, and create an engaging environment where students can learn by building and experimenting.

**Key Responsibilities**  
1\. STEM Curriculum Development \& Delivery

* Design and deliver structured STEM lessons covering Robotics, Electronics, Coding, AI, and emerging technologies.
* Customize teaching methods according to different age groups and skill levels.
* Conduct practical and activity\-based sessions that encourage students to learn through experimentation.
* Integrate multiple technologies into project\-based learning activities.

2\. Robotics \& Electronics

* Conduct hands\-on training using robotics kits, Arduino, sensors, motors, and basic electronic components.
* Teach students fundamental concepts of circuits, sensors, automation, and robotics.
* Guide students in building and programming simple robotic systems.
* Assist students in troubleshooting hardware, wiring, and robotics\-kit issues.

3\. Coding \& Python

* Teach beginner\-friendly programming concepts using **block\-based coding and Python**.
* Introduce students to programming fundamentals such as variables, conditions, loops, functions, and basic logic.
* Help students develop small applications, games, automation projects, and robotics programs.
* Introduce age\-appropriate computational thinking and problem\-solving concepts.

4\. Artificial Intelligence \& Generative AI

* Introduce students to the **fundamental concepts of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning** in a simple and age\-appropriate manner.
* Explain concepts such as AI, data, models, computer vision, natural language processing, and generative AI at a basic level.
* Conduct beginner\-friendly AI activities and projects.
* Introduce students to responsible and ethical use of AI.
* Demonstrate how AI tools can be used for learning, creativity, research, and problem\-solving.

5\. AI\-Assisted / Vibe Coding

* Introduce students to **AI\-assisted coding and beginner\-level “vibe coding” concepts**.
* Teach students how to describe an idea clearly and use AI coding assistants to help create simple applications and prototypes.
* Help students understand, test, modify, and debug AI\-generated code rather than simply copying it.
* Encourage students to combine creativity, problem\-solving, and programming to build small functional projects.

6\. 3D Printing \& Digital Fabrication

* Introduce students to the basics of **3D printing and digital fabrication**.
* Explain the basic workflow from idea → 3D design → slicing → printing.
* Guide students through simple 3D design/CAD activities.
* Demonstrate basic 3D\-printer operation, material handling, and print troubleshooting.
* Help students create simple physical prototypes and STEM models.

7\. Project\-Based Learning

* Guide students through practical projects combining robotics, coding, AI, electronics, and 3D printing.
* Encourage students to identify real\-world problems and develop technology\-based solutions.
* Support students in building prototypes and demonstrating their projects.
* Encourage creativity, experimentation, teamwork, and innovation.

8\. Classroom Instruction \& Student Engagement

* Conduct interactive and engaging sessions for students from Grades 1–10\.
* Create a positive classroom environment that encourages curiosity and experimentation.
* Explain technical concepts in a simple and student\-friendly manner.
* Manage classrooms effectively while maintaining a hands\-on learning environment.

9\. Student Assessment \& Feedback

* Monitor student progress and maintain performance records.
* Evaluate student understanding through activities, projects, and practical assessments.
* Provide constructive feedback to help students improve their technical and problem\-solving skills.
* Identify students who require additional guidance and support.

10\. Technical Support \& Troubleshooting

* Assist students in troubleshooting robotics kits, electronics, programming, AI tools, and 3D\-printing activities.
* Diagnose basic hardware and software issues during classroom sessions.
* Ensure STEM equipment and kits are properly maintained and ready for use.

11\. Mentorship

* Inspire students to explore Robotics, AI, Coding, Electronics, and other STEM fields.
* Encourage critical thinking, creativity, problem\-solving, and independent learning.
* Help students develop confidence in building and experimenting with technology.

12\. Collaboration \& Coordination

* Work closely with school teachers, administrators, and internal academic teams.
* Coordinate schedules and ensure smooth execution of STEM sessions across multiple schools.
* Maintain effective communication with school staff regarding student activities and requirements.

13\. Professional Development

* Stay updated with developments in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Python, coding, 3D printing, and STEM education.
* Continuously explore new educational technologies, AI tools, project ideas, and teaching methodologies.
* Participate in internal training and upskilling programs.

Qualifications

**Education:** Diploma / BSc / BE / B.Ed / M.Sc / M.Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, Physics, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields.

Candidates from other technical or STEM backgrounds with relevant practical skills may also be considered.

Experience

* Freshers are welcome; structured training will be provided.
* 1–2 years of experience in Robotics, STEM education, coding, AI education, or related areas is preferred.
* Experience working with school students or conducting workshops is an advantage.

**Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of **Robotics and Electronics**.
* Basic programming knowledge in **Arduino, Python, or Block\-based Coding**.
* Basic understanding of **Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI concepts**.
* Familiarity with **AI\-assisted coding / vibe coding** is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of **3D printing and digital fabrication** is an advantage.
* Strong communication and classroom\-management skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and engaging manner.
* Ability to engage and motivate students.
* Good organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Passion for STEM education, technology, and teaching.
* Willingness to travel to partner schools across Bangalore.

**Additional Benefits**

* Structured training and upskilling programs for freshers.
* Exposure to Robotics, AI, Python, 3D Printing, and emerging technologies.
* Opportunity to work with reputed schools across Bangalore.
* Hands\-on experience delivering technology education to school students.
* Opportunity to develop expertise across multiple areas of STEM education.
* Strong career growth opportunities in the **EdTech, Robotics, AI, and STEM education sectors**.

 Delta Exchange India is one of India's leading crypto derivatives platforms, offering INR\-settled futures and options on Bitcoin, Ethereum and other major cryptocurrencies on an FIU\-registered platform. **About the Role:** 




 We're looking for a
 **Community Manager – Algo Business** 
 to build one of the most trusted crypto algo trading communities.
 



 India's algo traders are scattered across Telegram groups, Discord servers and Twitter threads. We want Delta to be where that community actually lives — where a beginner deploys their first bot and an experienced quant compares notes on execution.
 



 This role is for someone who genuinely loves talking to algo traders. You'll spend your days in conversation with users — in Online forums, on calls, at meetups — and turn what you learn into content, events and product feedback. Success isn't measured in follower counts, but in how many traders are actively building and deploying on Delta.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own our community across Online Community forums — structure, rituals, moderation, day\-to\-day engagement.
* Be the first responder: answer questions, unblock traders, escalate bugs, make sure no API question goes unanswered.
* Identify and nurture power users and strategy builders; run ambassador and early\-access programmes.
* Plan and execute offline meetups, hackathons and strategy competitions across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR and other hubs — plus online AMAs, workshops and guest sessions.
* Create content that lowers the barrier to algo trading: getting\-started guides, API tutorials, strategy walkthroughs, backtesting explainers.
* Keep documentation, sample code and cookbooks genuinely useful — you should be able to write and test a basic strategy yourself.
* Capture community pain points and translate them into structured, prioritised product feedback.
* Track what's brewing globally — agentic tooling, AI copilots, no\-code automation — and bring it back to our users and our roadmap.
* Define and track community metrics: active builders, deployed strategies, resolution time, new\-trader retention.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 1–3 years in community management, developer relations, growth, content or a trader\-facing role. Exceptional candidates with less formal experience but deep algo credibility will be considered.
* **A real understanding of algo trading** 
 — you know what a backtest is, why slippage matters, what a webhook does. You don't need to be a quant, but you can't be faking it in front of one.
* **You genuinely enjoy talking to traders.** 
 This role involves hundreds of conversations a month.
* Awareness of the algo landscape in India and globally — the tools, the communities, the interesting builders, where it's heading.
* Strong written communication: a clear tutorial, a crisp announcement, well\-structured product feedback.
* Comfort with technical material — API docs, sample code, explaining a strategy to a beginner.
* Self\-starter with strong ownership, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to travel for events.



  





**Good to Have:** 



* Hands\-on experience building, backtesting or running your own strategies or bots.

+ Secure Boot

+ Secure Firmware Loading
+ Secure Debug Access
+ Secure Key Provisioning
+ Anti\-Tamper Mechanisms

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
In today's world, where data spreads across various clouds and devices, traditional security measures aren't enough. Businesses need a dynamic approach to defend against constant cyber threats and ensure agile data security. Fortanix leads the way in data\-centric cybersecurity for hybrid multicloud environments, using advanced cryptography, encryption, and confidential AI solutions.
   

  

 As data breaches become more frequent and traditional defenses fall short, we focus on data exposure management to keep your information safe. Our unified data security platform addresses vulnerabilities in hybrid multicloud environments, defends against threats, and makes it easier to discover, assess, and fix data exposure risks. Whether implementing a Zero Trust model or preparing for the post\-quantum computing era, we help businesses worldwide protect their most sensitive data, wherever it is.
   

  

 Our commitment to solving the world's toughest data security challenges has earned Fortanix multiple Cybersecurity Excellence and Innovation Awards, as well as recognition from industry giants such as NVIDIA, Microsoft, Intel, ServiceNow, and Snowflake.
   

  

 Our team includes industry leaders and cryptography experts, creating a culture of trust, innovation and collaboration where every voice is valued. Recognized as a Great Place to Work, we're looking for passionate individuals to help us shape the future of data security and work towards a safer digital future.
   

  

 Fortanix helps enterprises protect their most sensitive data and AI models while they're in use, not just at rest or in transit. Our Confidential AI platform let customers run models and workloads inside hardware\-backed trusted execution environments, release keys only to attested workloads, and prove to auditors that nobody, including the cloud provider, could see their data.
   

  

 Enterprises and frontier model providers each bring their own architecture and security requirements, and fitting our platform to those needs is where the real engineering happens. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll close that gap. You'll embed with customers and partners, design and develop solutions and integrations, debug problems from firmware to Kubernetes, and bring what you learn back into the product and the open\-source community.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role. You'll design the architecture with the customer, then write the code, ship the fixes, and own the outcome.
   

  

 In this role, you will:
   

  

* Design and develop customer solutions. Understand each enterprise or frontier model provider's AI and security architecture, then design and build how Fortanix Confidential AI platform fit into it, from reference architecture through working integration.
* Build integrations. Develop the connectors and workload tooling that tie our platform into customers' existing stacks, and orchestration systems.
* Architect the trust model. Design attestation and key\-release flows for each customer's workloads, covering composite attestation, and how keys and models are protected end to end.
* Build proofs of concept that prove value. Scope and develop POCs with clear success criteria and propose designs that meets enterprise objectives.
* Shape the product. Turn what you learn in the field into RFCs, feature designs, and product requirements, and work with core product and engineering to land them.
* Contribute upstream. Participate in the open\-source community through code, reviews, and RFCs.
* Create reusable assets. Turn one\-off solutions into reference architectures, sample workloads, and design patterns that the next customer and the wider team can build on.


**Requirements**
* 4\-7 years of hands\-on experience in systems, infrastructure, platform, or security engineering, with meaningful time spent in customer\-facing roles.
* Strong Linux systems skills: kernel boot, systemd, storage and filesystems, networking, PCIe devices.
* Working experience with OpenShift, Kubernetes, Slurm is preferred.
* Proficiency in at least one of Rust, Go, or Python. You're comfortable reading an unfamiliar codebase and making a targeted change.
* Familiarity with cryptography and PKI: certificates, key formats, TLS, signing, and key management concepts.
* Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain attestation to a CISO in one meeting and debug a TDX quote failure with their platform team in the next.
* The ability to work independently, set expectations, and escalate early


 You'll work at the frontier where AI meets hardware security, on problems that very few engineers in the world have solved. Your work will directly decide whether the largest enterprises and AI providers can trust their most sensitive models and data to run anywhere.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Hybrid Work Model
* 12 Annual Leaves \& 12 Casual/Sick Leaves
* 8 Public Holidays \+ 2 Floating Holiday
* Comprehensive Medical and Dental Insurance Coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
* Group Life Insurance
* Personal Accident Insurance
* Internet Reimbursement
* Employee Stock Options
* Onsite Snacks, Lunches, and Dinners Provided
* Quarterly Beer Bashes \& Year\-End Celebrations

Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other status. If you're interested in working in a fast\-growing, exciting working environment \- we encourage you to apply !*

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Full Stack Developer** 





 📍 Kakkanad, Kochi \| Full\-time \| Onsite
 




**Experience: 0–3 years** 




  






 Samosa Interactive is looking for a
 
**Full Stack Developer** 

 to join our engineering team in Kochi.
 





 We are a young product and technology company building software across logistics, retail operations, food\-tech, gamification and interactive digital experiences.
 





 This is not a role where you will spend months working on one small module.
 





 You could be working on a fleet operations platform one week, improving a self\-ordering kiosk experience the next, or building features for a completely new product after that. We work on both our own products and real client deployments, so the things you build will actually be used by businesses and their customers.
 





 Candidates returning to work after a career break are also welcome to apply. If a startup environment excites you and you want to get back into a hands\-on, real\-world building environment, we’d be happy to hear from you.
 




  




**What you'll work on** 
   
 

 You will be involved across the product development cycle, including:
 





 • Building responsive web applications using React.js / Next.js
 





 • Developing backend services and APIs using Node.js / Express.js
 





 • Working with databases such as MySQL, and Postgres
 





 • Integrating frontend applications with APIs and third\-party services
 





 • Building authentication, role\-based access and business workflows
 





 • App development for Android, iOS, and Web using React Native with Expo
 





 • Frontend development using Tailwind CSS framework
 





 • Working with payment, notification and other external integrations when required
 





 • Debugging production issues and improving application performance
 





 • Collaborating closely with design, product and the rest of the engineering team
 





 • Taking features from requirement to development, testing and deployment
 





 • Contributing to technical discussions and suggesting better ways to build things
 




  




**What we're looking for** 
   
 

 We care more about your ability to
 
**build, learn and take ownership** 

 than the number of technologies listed on your resume.
 





 You should have:
 





 • Strong fundamentals in JavaScript / TypeScript
 





 • Good working knowledge of React.js
 





 • Experience with Next.js and Tailwind CSS are preferred
 





 • Working knowledge of Node.js and Express.js
 





 • Experience working with REST APIs
 





 • Understanding of databases, preferably Postgres
 





 • Good understanding of Git and collaborative development workflows like Merge, Rebase, Pull Requests, Merge conflict resolution etc.
 





 • Ability to understand an existing codebase and work independently on assigned features
 





 • A practical approach to debugging and problem\-solving
 





 • Willingness to learn technologies outside your current comfort zone
 




  




**Experience** 
   
 

 We are looking for candidates with
 
**0–3 years of experience** 

 .
 





 Freshers with strong fundamentals and solid personal, academic or freelance projects are welcome to apply.
 





 For us, what you have actually built matters more than simply having a certain number of years on your resume.
 




  




**We'd especially like to talk if** 
   
 

 • You have built and deployed projects beyond tutorials
 





 • You have handled both frontend and backend development
 





 • You enjoy figuring things out instead of waiting for detailed instructions for every step
 





 • You care about the actual user experience, not just whether the code works
 





 • You are comfortable working in a small team where your contribution is visible
 





 • You want exposure to building multiple real\-world products from the ground up
 




  




**What this role is not** 
   
 

 This is probably not the right role if you are looking for a highly structured environment where every requirement is already documented and every technical decision has already been made.
 





 We are still building Samosa Interactive, which means priorities can move, products evolve and engineers are expected to think along with us.
 





 At the same time, you will get the opportunity to work closely with the people making the product and business decisions, and see your work move from an idea to something being used in the real world.
 




  




**Location** 
   
 

 This is an
 
**onsite role from our Kakkanad, Kochi office** 

 .
 




  




**Interview process** 
   
 

 The process will include:
 



1. A conversational discussion to understand you, the work you have done and how you approach problems
2. A detailed technical discussion around your fundamentals, projects and development approach




 We are not interested in making candidates go through five rounds of interviews or solving random algorithm puzzles that have nothing to do with the job.
 




  




**Interested?** 
   
 

 Apply through LinkedIn with your resume and, if available, links to your
 
**GitHub, portfolio or projects you have actually built** 

 .
 





 If your resume only tells us the technologies you know, show us something you have built. That will always tell us more.
 




  





**Samosa Interactive Private Limited** 





 Kakkanad, Kochi

title: UAV Designer — Modelling, Simulation & Autopilot
description:
**Company Description** 
 SkyVector Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a fast\-growing company based in Hyderabad, India, specializing in Advanced Electronics, Aerospace, Defence, and Electronic Warfare systems. The organization delivers cutting\-edge solutions for defence and aerospace programs, combining deep engineering expertise with a strong culture of innovation. Teams at SkyVector work on indigenous product development across embedded systems, firmware, PCB design, and mission\-critical electronic systems. The company is driven by precision, quality, and a passion for solving complex engineering challenges, and is actively expanding its engineering workforce. Applicants will join a collaborative environment focused on building technology that has real\-world impact.
 



  





**Role Description:** 




**UAV Designer — Modelling, Simulation \& Autopilot** 




 Hyderabad, Telangana \| Fixed\-Wing UAV Program \| Full\-Time \| Defence, Aerospace \& EW Electronics
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work on real, mission\-critical hardware for defence and aerospace platforms — not simulations or academic exercises
* Direct exposure to founders on every major design call — this is not a siloed role several layers removed from decisions
* A genuine hand in a defence\-relevant program from an early stage, including the IP and documentation that comes out of it
* We're a fast\-growing company — compensation grows quickly with demonstrated performance, not just tenure



  





**Compensation** 




 As a startup, we're not able to match big\-company salaries right now — but we're growing fast, and early team members get real ownership over what they build, faster growth in responsibility, and compensation that scales quickly with performance rather than waiting on annual cycles.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on
 **flight\-dynamics and autopilot role** 
 , not a general software or coding role. You should be someone who has actually built
 **6\-DOF dynamics models** 
 and worked on
 **real autopilot/GNC logic** 




 — not just studied aerodynamics or written general\-purpose code.
 **If your background is in software development, computer science, or IT with no UAV, aircraft, or flight\-dynamics project work, please do not apply.** 
 This posting is exclusively for candidates with an Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering background and real UAV/aircraft\-relevant project experience.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're after someone who can sit across modelling \& simulation, autopilot/GNC, and the aerodynamics\-and\-structures side of a fixed\-wing airframe — not necessarily expert in all three on day one, but able to move between them without needing a translator. You'll build and maintain the 6\-DOF dynamics model, help shape the autopilot logic that flies on it, and weigh in on airframe decisions (wing loading, control surface sizing, launch loads) that the model and the autopilot both depend on getting right.
 



  





**Minimum Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering or Mechanical Engineering — aerospace is the closer fit, but a mechanical background with real aircraft or UAV project work is welcome (CGPA 7\.5\+ or equivalent — applications below this will not be considered)
* 2–5 years working on UAV or aircraft flight dynamics, autopilot/GNC, or aerodynamics — industry, a research lab, or a genuinely serious student UAV/rocketry project all count



  





**What You'll Be Doing** 



* Building and maintaining 6\-DOF flight dynamics models and using them to drive hardware/software\-in\-the\-loop (HIL/SIL) testing before anything goes near a real airframe
* Working on autopilot and guidance logic — L1/NLGL\-style guidance, PID and lead\-compensator loops, EKF\-based state estimation — and tuning it against both simulation and flight\-test data
* Running aerodynamic analysis (stability derivatives, trim, control\-surface sizing) so the airframe can actually fly the mission it's meant to
* Sanity\-checking structural and launch\-load questions — canister\-launch acceleration, wing\-fold mechanisms, airframe weight budget
* Setting up sensor simulation (IMU, GNSS, baro, compass) for OBC\-in\-the\-loop testing of the flight controller
* Debugging the gap between "works in simulation" and "works on the bench"
* Writing up trajectory, launch\-angle, and performance analysis clearly for the team and future reviewers



  





**You Must Have Real Comfort With** 



* Flight dynamics modelling (MATLAB/Simulink, Python, or equivalent) — able to build a 6\-DOF model from equations of motion, not just run someone else's
* Autopilot fundamentals: guidance laws, PID/compensator tuning, and at least a conceptual grip on state estimation (EKF or similar)
* Aerodynamics background sufficient to reason about stability, trim, and control\-surface authority
* Basic structural/load reasoning and airframe structural design fundamentals — load paths, material selection, basic sizing



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Hands\-on HIL/SIL experience, canister\- or rail\-launched airframe experience, familiarity with ArduPilot/PX4/custom FCS at code level, actuator control exposure, or a fly\-off/competition track record (SAE Aero, DBF, or similar)



  





**To Apply** 




 Send your resume to
 **career@skyvector.in** 
 with subject line
 **"Application for – UAV Designer"** 
 . In your email body, mention your full name, Total years of experience, Current CTC, Expected CTC, along with one flight\-dynamics, autopilot, or aerodynamics project you've personally worked on end\-to\-end and what platform it was for.

title: Robotics Instructor
description:
**Company Description** 




 NASCA is a STEAM\-focused education organization that uses innovative instructional practices to nurture critical thinking and creativity in school students. All training modules follow “Whole Brain Teaching,” aligning learning with how the brain naturally processes information. NASCA promotes practical, activity\-based learning and “Learning by Doing,” integrating Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Math with real\-world applications. The program emphasizes hands\-on lab work, collaborative experimentation, and a strong maker culture to develop problem\-solving skills and higher\-order thinking. NASCA’s mission is to make school education more holistic, impactful, and future\-ready, equipping learners with skills for emerging market realities and opportunities.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Robotics Instructor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai. This position involves designing and delivering engaging robotics and STEM lessons aligned with NASCA’s activity\-based and “Learning by Doing” pedagogy. The instructor will guide students through hands\-on projects, programming tasks, and lab\-based experimentation using robotics kits and related tools. Daily responsibilities include preparing lesson plans, managing classroom and lab activities, assessing student learning, and providing individualized support to help learners build problem\-solving and creative thinking skills. The Robotics Instructor will also collaborate with school staff to integrate robotics into the broader curriculum, maintain equipment, and contribute to continuous improvement of teaching materials and methodologies.
 



  




* Place of Deputation : Mumbai(South Mumbai)
* Employment : Full time (On Site)



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Engineering Degree / B.Tech / M. Tech in Electronics
* Must Know HTML, JAVA, SQL, Programming Languages
* Proficiency in Python / ARDUINO IDE / SAS /Matlab



  






 Experience
 



* Candidates must have minimum 2 \- 3 years of teaching experience.

* Must have excellent academic credentials

* Effective Communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and engage diverse learners.

* Demonstrated ability to facilitate activity\-based, learner\-centered instruction and manage classroom dynamics.

* Ability to work collaboratively with educators, administrators, and other stakeholders to align programs with school curricula.

description:
**About the Role:**

We are looking for a motivated and energetic Field Sales Executive to promote and sell our packaging products to businesses across Hyderabad and surrounding areas. The ideal candidate should be willing to travel, meet customers, generate new business opportunities, and maintain strong client relationships.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Visit retail stores, wholesalers, distributors, supermarkets, manufacturers, restaurants, hospitals, and other businesses to generate sales.
* Identify and approach new customers in assigned territories.
* Promote the company's range of compostable, biodegradable, and conventional plastic packaging products.
* Explain product features, pricing, and benefits to customers.
* Generate enquiries, quotations, and follow up until orders are confirmed.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with customers.
* Meet daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
* Collect market feedback, competitor information, and customer requirements.

* Graduate or Intermediate (Any discipline).

* Self\-motivated with a positive attitude.
* Willingness to travel extensively for customer visits.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office and smartphone applications.
* Must possess a valid two\-wheeler driving licence and own a bike.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in B2B sales.
* Ability to build customer relationships.
* Strong presentation and convincing skills.
* Ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.

**Important Requirement Location \& Travel:**

* The candidate must be willing to report to our Medchal office/factory as required.

**Salary \& Benefits:**

* Competitive Salary
* Travel Allowance (TA)
* Performance Incentives
* Mobile Allowance (if applicable)
* Career Growth Opportunities
* Training on Products and Sales Techniques

**Products You'll Sell:**

* Compostable Carry Bags

* Conventional Plastic Packaging Products
