About J.K. Subsea Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

J.K. Subsea Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is an engineering company serving industrial, offshore, subsea, oil \& gas and other specialized engineering sectors.

We are looking for a **Mechanical Design Engineer** who can work on practical engineering design activities involving mechanical components, assemblies, piping\-related products, fittings, equipment and customized engineering requirements.

The position is suitable for a Mechanical Engineer who enjoys **actual engineering and design work** and is comfortable working with drawings, dimensions, materials, specifications and manufacturing requirements.

Job Responsibilities

* Prepare 2D and 3D mechanical drawings for components, assemblies and engineering products.
* Develop and modify mechanical designs based on customer requirements and technical specifications.
* Prepare detailed manufacturing drawings with dimensions, tolerances, material specifications and other relevant details.
* Understand customer drawings, specifications, BOMs and technical requirements.
* Prepare and maintain **BOMs (Bill of Materials)**.
* Assist in selection of suitable materials, components and manufacturing processes.
* Coordinate with production, purchase, suppliers and vendors regarding design and manufacturing requirements.
* Review drawings received from customers and identify technical requirements or discrepancies.
* Make design modifications based on customer feedback and manufacturing requirements.
* Prepare design calculations wherever required.
* Support the engineering team in development of customized products and assemblies.
* Assist in preparation of technical documentation, datasheets and product drawings.
* Ensure drawings are properly revised, controlled and maintained.
* Coordinate with suppliers/manufacturers for technical clarifications.
* Support the Sales and Engineering teams in understanding technical requirements during quotation and order execution.
* Carry out basic engineering calculations related to dimensions, loads, pressure, material selection and mechanical components as applicable to the product.
* Participate in product improvement and value\-engineering activities.

Required Technical Skills

The candidate should have working knowledge of:

* Mechanical engineering drawing and drafting
* 2D CAD software – **AutoCAD preferred**
* 3D CAD software such as **SolidWorks / Solid Edge / Inventor / Creo** or equivalent
* GD\&T basics
* Engineering tolerances and fits
* Material specifications
* Manufacturing processes
* Machining and fabrication basics
* BOM preparation
* Reading engineering drawings
* Basic mechanical design calculations
* MS Excel and MS Office

Knowledge of **pressure\-rated components, piping, fittings, valves, hydraulic systems, instrumentation or offshore equipment** will be an advantage.

Educational Qualification

**Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering/Instrumentation Engineering/ Production Engineering/** 

Candidates with a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering and relevant practical design experience may also be considered.

Experience

**2–5 years of relevant mechanical design experience preferred.**

Candidates with experience in any of the following industries/products may apply:

* Industrial equipment
* Mechanical components
* Pressure equipment
* Valves and fittings
* Hydraulic equipment
* Piping systems
* Oil \& Gas
* Offshore / Marine
* Subsea equipment
* Engineering fabrication
* Machined components
* Industrial machinery

We are looking for a **practical Design Engineer**, not someone who is only familiar with CAD software.

The candidate should be able to:

* Understand what is being designed and why.
* Convert an engineering requirement into a workable drawing.
* Think about how a component will actually be manufactured.
* Understand dimensions, tolerances and materials.
* Communicate with production and vendors regarding drawings.
* Make corrections and revisions independently.
* Take ownership of assigned design work.
* Learn new products and engineering applications.

Freshers with strong practical knowledge of CAD and mechanical design may also be considered for a junior position.

Key Performance Areas (KRA)

The Design Engineer will be responsible for:

* Timely completion of drawings and design assignments.
* Accuracy of 2D and 3D drawings.
* Correct dimensions, tolerances and material specifications.
* Proper preparation and maintenance of BOMs.
* Minimizing drawing errors and revisions.
* Coordination with production, purchase and suppliers.
* Timely completion of customer drawing modifications.
* Supporting development of customized engineering products.
* Maintaining proper revision and document control.
* Providing practical and manufacturable design solutions.

Preferred Candidate Profile

A candidate with **2–5 years of practical mechanical design experience** will be preferred.

Experience in an engineering manufacturing, fabrication, industrial equipment, hydraulic, piping, oil \& gas, offshore or similar environment will be an advantage.

The candidate should be comfortable working in a **small/medium\-sized engineering organization**, where the role may involve both design and coordination rather than being restricted to only CAD drafting.

Important

**Practical knowledge and ability to execute design work will be given more importance than qualification alone.**

Candidates should be willing to work closely with other departments and take responsibility for their assigned engineering work.

Salary

**₹25,000 – ₹40,000 per month**, depending on experience, technical skills and suitability for the role.

This is a hands\-on role requiring the candidate to actively coordinate between production, suppliers, outlets, drivers and other team members to ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations.

Key Responsibilities

Quality \& Production Control

Ensure the quality, consistency and safety of all products manufactured by the company.

Monitor production processes and ensure products meet the company's required standards.

Check daily production output against requirements and identify shortages or production issues.

Maintain proper hygiene, cleanliness and food\-safety standards throughout the production premises.

Monitor proper handling and storage of raw materials and finished products.

Help reduce wastage and improve production efficiency.

Inventory \& Stock Management

Monitor inventory of raw materials, packaging materials and finished products.

Ensure sufficient stock of the company's manufactured and retail products is maintained.

Regularly check stock requirements of all company outlets.

Coordinate replenishment and stock transfers to prevent products from going out of stock.

Identify fast\-moving and low\-stock products and plan requirements accordingly.

Purchase \& Supplier Coordination

Coordinate with suppliers and place orders for required raw materials and other products.

Follow up with suppliers to ensure materials are received on time.

Coordinate with the company driver regarding collection and delivery of materials and products.

Ensure all outlets receive their required raw materials, retail products and manufactured products on time.

Bulk Orders \& Client Coordination

Receive and coordinate bulk orders from external clients.

Plan production and product requirements according to the order quantity and delivery deadline.

Coordinate with production staff, packing staff, drivers and other team members to ensure orders are prepared correctly.

Ensure bulk orders are completed, packed and dispatched within the committed time.

Candidate We Are Looking For

Freshers are welcome to apply.

Energetic, proactive and willing to take responsibility.

Organised and capable of handling multiple tasks simultaneously.

Comfortable working with production teams, suppliers, drivers and outlet staff.

Able to identify problems and take timely action rather than waiting for instructions.

Willing to adapt to changing operational conditions and company requirements.

Comfortable with a role that involves both technical food\-quality responsibilities and practical day\-to\-day operations.

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the work. The Food Technologist will play an important role in ensuring that the right products are produced at the right quality and quantity, sufficient stock reaches every outlet, raw materials arrive on time, and customer/bulk orders are completed without delays.

The role offers an opportunity to learn and grow alongside an expanding food manufacturing and retail business.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Our platforms optimize operations across marine and rail terminals, yard management, transportation management, and fleet maintenance, enabling greater efficiency, safety, and visibility.
   

  

 Our Yard Management System (YMS) helps companies manage the movement of trailers, containers, drivers, and other assets within their facilities. By connecting yard operations, transportation processes, automation, and real\-time visibility, Kaleris enables customers to improve yard efficiency, reduce manual work, and make better operational decisions.

 **Product Manager Intern**

 Required

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: Product Manager
description:
**The Role, in One Sentence**
 You own the bridge between Customer Success and Engineering — making sure engineering builds what customers can actually use, and making sure customers understand, adopt, and champion what gets built.
   

  

**The Three Metrics You Will Be Measured On**
**Product usage — are customers actually using the modules they pay for**
**Product champions — are there named people inside our accounts who advocate for us**
**Recurring revenue — retention and expansion, as an outcome of the first two**
 Everything below serves these three. If an activity doesn't move one of them, it isn't the job.
   

  

**What This Job Actually Is**
 Read this section carefully. It is the most important part of this posting.
   

  

 What It Means Day to Day
   

  

 \~40% Product
   

  

 Owning the roadmap for existing modules. Prioritisation. Writing specs. Relentlessly simplifying — fewer clicks, less jargon, usable by a 55\-year\-old warden and a 19\-year\-old student alike. Deciding what does not get built.
   

  

 \~30% Engineering \& Delivery
   

  

 Sprint planning, grooming, scope management, release coordination, UAT, post\-release verification. Working daily with our Tech Lead and engineering team.
   

  

 \~30% Customer\-Facing Product Work
   

  

 Product demos. Feature training. Webinars. Roadmap sessions that get customers excited about what's coming. Gathering requirements first\-hand rather than second\-hand.
   

  

 Travel is occasional, not routine. Most customer work is remote. Expect on\-site visits some months and none in others.
   

  

**What This Job Is Not**
* Not account management. We have a Customer Success team. They own accounts, escalations, support tickets, and day\-to\-day service. You do not.
* Not a growth role. There is no funnel to optimise, no experimentation programme, no PLG motion. If your last three years were Mixpanel dashboards and A/B tests, this will make you unhappy within six months.
* Not pure product, not pure engineering. You will not sit in Figma all day, and you will not be writing code. You will spend your time translating in both directions — and the translation is the value.


**What You Will Own**
 Product
   

  

* Roadmap for existing modules — user management, leave and attendance, tickets and assets, mess, amenities, checklists, visitor management, finance, notifications
* Prioritisation across competing asks from Customer Success, Sales, and Engineering
* Simplification as a discipline. Our users are not software people. When engineering ships something in six clicks, your job is to ask why it isn't three. When a screen uses internal terminology, your job is to catch it before a customer does.
* Saying no — to customers, to Sales, and to engineering — with a reason that holds
* Protecting the roadmap from one\-off customisations that fork the product


 Delivery
   

  

* Sprint planning, grooming, and release coordination with the Tech Lead and engineering team
* Turning requirements into specs engineering can act on, with the "why" intact
* UAT and post\-release verification — confirming it works for the customer, not just in staging
* Never committing a date engineering hasn't agreed to


 Customer\-Facing Product Work
   

  

* Product demos that make non\-technical institutional buyers want the product
* Training existing customers on new features so they actually get adopted
* Webinars and roadmap sessions across the customer base
* Building product champions inside accounts — the people who will renew and expand us
* First\-hand requirement gathering, so we aren't building from a game of telephone


 Systems, Not Heroics
   

  

* Every commitment logged. No verbal promises that live only in your head.
* Building the process so it runs without founder involvement.


**Must\-Haves**
* 3\+ years of full\-time product management, post\-graduation, with real ownership specs, prioritisation, sprints, releases.

title: Performance Video Editor
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Performance Video Editor**

**Role**

Performance Video Editor

**Work Mode**

Remote / Work From Home

**Experience**

Fresher or 1 year of relevant experience

**Salary / Budget**

₹10,000 – ₹20,000 per month

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a creative and performance\-focused Video Editor who can transform scripts, hooks, raw footage, and concepts into highly engaging video creatives designed for social media and performance marketing.

The ideal candidate should not only know how to edit videos but also understand why a video works — including hooks, pacing, captions, music, cuts, visual storytelling, and current market trends.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Create High\-Performing Video Creatives**

* Produce 3–5 highly engaging video creatives per day, depending on project requirements.
* Create videos designed to capture attention quickly and maintain viewer retention.
* Experiment with different editing styles, pacing, transitions, visual patterns, and storytelling techniques.

**2\. Understand the Script**

* Read and understand the complete script before starting the edit.
* Identify the key message, emotions, important moments, and intended audience.
* Translate the script into strong visual storytelling.

**3\. Understand Hooks \& Caption Position**

* Understand the importance of the first 1–3 seconds of a video.
* Position hooks and captions strategically for maximum visibility and attention.
* Ensure text is readable, correctly timed, and visually aligned with the content.

**4\. Background Music \& Audio**

* Select appropriate background music based on the emotion and objective of the video.
* Understand music volume, timing, beats, and transitions.
* Keep dialogue/voice\-over clear and properly balanced with background music.
* Use sound effects where they improve engagement.

**5\. Engaging Cuts \& Pacing**

* Create dynamic and purposeful cuts based on the script and audio.
* Remove unnecessary pauses and dead moments.
* Use B\-roll, zooms, motion, transitions, text animations, and visual changes where appropriate.
* Maintain strong pacing throughout the video.

**6\. Stay Updated With Market Trends**

* Research trending video formats, editing styles, hooks, caption patterns, transitions, and creative trends.
* Understand what is currently working across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, and Reels.
* Bring new editing ideas and references to the team.
* Continuously experiment with new approaches.

**7\. Editing Tools \& Technical Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of CapCut.
* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro.
* After Effects — added advantage.
* Other relevant editing tools.
* Knowledge of video cutting and sequencing, text animation, captions/subtitles, transitions, B\-roll, sound effects, background music, basic motion graphics, and social\-media formats and aspect ratios.

**8\. Colour Correction \& Visual Quality**

* Perform basic colour correction and colour grading.
* Maintain consistent skin tones, exposure, contrast, and overall visual quality.
* Ensure the final video looks clean, professional, and platform\-ready.

**9\. Deadline \& Task Discipline**

* Complete assigned tasks within the given deadline.
* Maintain consistent output without compromising quality.
* Inform the manager before the deadline if there is any genuine blocker or delay.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks from brief to final delivery.

**10\. Communication \& Problem Solving**

* If there is any issue with the script, footage, brief, editing direction, or deadline, communicate with the manager without delay.
* Ask questions when requirements are unclear.
* Be proactive in identifying problems and suggesting solutions.

**11\. Support Bulk Creative Production**

* Work efficiently in a high\-volume creative production environment.
* Help the team produce creatives at scale while maintaining quality and consistency.
* Follow the team's creative workflow and production SOP.
* Handle multiple creative variations efficiently.
* Maintain proper file organization and naming conventions.

**What We Expect**

* Strong attention to detail
* Creative thinking
* Good understanding of social\-media content
* Fast execution with quality
* Strong sense of pacing and storytelling
* Willingness to experiment
* Ability to take feedback positively
* Ownership of deadlines
* Clear and proactive communication
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

**Preferred Candidate**

* Fresher with strong editing skills OR 1 year of relevant experience
* Portfolio demonstrating short\-form video editing skills
* Experience with Instagram Reels, Meta Ads, YouTube Shorts, or similar content is an advantage.
* Performance marketing creative experience is an added advantage.

**Performance Standard**

A successful Video Editor should be able to:

**Understand → Edit → Review → Improve → Deliver**

The goal is not simply to make a video.

**The goal is to create a video that is:**

**Attention\-Grabbing \+ Engaging \+ Visually Strong \+ On\-Brand \+ Performance\-Focused**

**Core Mindset**

***“Don't just edit what you're given. Understand the objective behind the creative and make the edit better.”***

***How to apply :***  
***Send your resume to : roshani@inspireglobalventure.com***

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Officer - Group operations
description:
The Officer – Group Operations supports the Vetting Desk in two areas: vessel vetting (RightShip, Q88 and related questionnaires) and ship security (ISPS Code). The role tracks inspections, keeps vetting and security records up to date, follows up on findings until closed, supports Ship Security Plan work, security intelligence and guidance for vessels in high\-risk areas, and reports compliance status to management. The role works to set procedures under the guidance of the Operations Manager.




**ROLES ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**Vetting**

* Upload inspection reports, findings, RCAs and CAPs to the RightShip portal and internal databases accurately and on time.
* Follow up with ship staff and business units on corrective actions until all findings are closed.
* Prepare, update and submit Q88, Baltic Questionnaire and other vetting questionnaires, and keep vessel certificate records current.

**Ship Security**

* Assist in preparing and amending Ship Security Plans (SSPs), including collecting vessel data and updating GA Plans after flag or class changes.
* Send standard security guidance to vessels entering high\-risk areas; track vessel reporting deadlines and send reminders.
* Draft and send CSO messages and security circulars; keep the PMSC list up to date.
* Support vessels preparing for ISPS audits, RightShip inspections and dry docks with documents and follow\-up.
* Collect and map maritime security intelligence from threat feeds, advisories and incident reports; brief the desk on risks to fleet vessels and trading routes.
* Manage day\-to\-day contact with ship staff, business units, CSOs, security providers and external authorities on security matters.

**Reporting and Administration**

* Prepare regular reports and dashboards on inspection status, findings trends, Safety Score and security compliance.
* Maintain files, databases and SOPs; track invoices for desk services; take part in process improvement and training.
* Take on additional roles or desk processes, or move internally within Group Operations, as business needs require.

 **Requirements**  

**KEY SKILLS AND CAPABILITIES:**

**Technical skills**

* Working knowledge of the ISM and ISPS Codes, ship security plans and guidance for high\-risk areas.
* Understanding of RightShip inspections, Q88 and vetting questionnaires, and the RCA and CAP process.
* Maritime security intelligence mapping: tracking threats and incidents and relating them to fleet routes.
* Use of AI tools and a sound understanding of data; MS Office 365 and Power BI or similar.

**Professional skills**

* Project management and project support: planning, tracking actions and reporting progress.
* Good written and spoken English; clear, confident dealings with internal and external stakeholders.
* Well organised and accurate; handles confidential documents securely and manages several deadlines at once.

**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:**

* Master's degree in International Business or International Relations.
* Bachelor's degree in Maritime Studies, Political Science or Business Administration.
* 1–2 years in ship management support, vetting, maritime security or compliance. Freshers keen to learn may be considered.
* Knowledge of RightShip procedures, Q88 or the ISPS Code preferred.

  

**Benefits** **About Anglo\-Eastern**


Anglo\-Eastern is a global leader in independent ship management services. The Group manages over 700 vessels under full technical management, supports around 500 additional ships under crew management, and has overseen more than 1,000 newbuildings and conversions through its newbuilding supervision and project management divisions.


Headquartered in Hong Kong, Anglo\-Eastern operates through a network of 30 offices across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, including wholly owned maritime training facilities. Our strength lies in our people: over 39,000 seafarers and 2,350 shore\-based employees who work together to support clients across ship types while building trust, driving performance, and shaping a better maritime future.

 **Why join Anglo\-Eastern?**

* Join a globally respected company with a strong maritime heritage of over 50 years
* Work in an environment anchored in integrity, trust, and long\-term relationships
* Access continuous learning and structured career development across a truly global network
* Be part of a team committed to delivering excellence and shaping a better maritime future

  

Join us today!

title: Social Media Motion Designer
description:
**About MaximusLabs**
 MaximusLabs is an AI\-first growth and visibility agency. We help B2B SaaS and AI startups get found and recommended on AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews, alongside classic Google search.
   

  

 Our work is measured in inbound leads, pipeline and revenue, not vanity metrics. We work closely with founders and growth teams at early and growth stage companies.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a Motion Designer who lives on social media and has real taste for reels. Motion design is the heart of this role. You will turn our ideas about AI search into short videos, reels and animated visuals that make people stop scrolling. You will also run the posting calendar that gets them out every week.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, full\-time role. You will animate, edit, design and publish, working directly with the founder.
   

  

**Fresher friendly: your work matters, not your years**
 Experience is a plus, not a requirement. Once you apply, we will send you an assignment. Do it well and send it back. If we love your assignment, we will hire you, even with zero years of experience. The quality of your work is the only thing we judge.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Create motion graphics and animated explainers: kinetic typography, animated charts, product and screen walkthroughs
* Edit short form videos (reels, shorts, LinkedIn videos) from raw footage, screen recordings and talking head clips
* Design static visuals for social media: carousels, post graphics, thumbnails and cover images
* Manage our social media calendar and keep a steady publishing cadence across our channels
* Track what performs (views, watch time, saves, shares) and use it to sharpen the next round
* Keep every piece on brand, and build reusable templates so we can ship faster
* Spot new formats and trends early, and adapt them to our voice


**What We Are Looking For**
* Motion design skills: you can make type, shapes and footage move with intent
* Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro, or equivalents like DaVinci Resolve or CapCut
* A sharp eye for typography, pacing, colour and composition
* An instinct for hooks: you know what makes the first two seconds of a reel work
* A feel for what performs on each social platform
* Clear written and spoken English, and comfort with fast feedback loops
* The ability to own a piece from brief to published post


**Good to have**
* 1 to 3 years of experience in motion design, video editing or social media (freshers are welcome)
* A portfolio or social account that shows your work (personal projects count)
* Figma or Canva for static design
* Experience with AI image and video tools
* Interest in B2B SaaS, AI or marketing
* Sound design and caption styling


**What You Will Get**
* Direct work with the founder, and a real say in how MaximusLabs shows up online
* Room to experiment with new formats and AI video tools
* Room to grow into a content or creative lead role as our content engine scales


**How We Hire**
* Apply with your resume, plus a link to any work you have made if you have one.
* We send you an assignment.
* You send it back. If the work is great, we talk next.


**Location**
 This is a full\-time, in\-office role. We are hiring in Bengaluru and Coimbatore, India, and this posting is for the city shown above.
   

  

 Skills: motion graphics,graphic design,video editing,motion design,social media management,after effects,premiere pro

title: Intern - Technical Writer
description:
**About Technical Writing** 




 A Technical Writer explains complex topics in a simple and clear language that end users can
 



 understand and apply effectively. Technical writers are primarily involved in creating User
 



 Guides for a product (hardware or software).
 



  





**Content Writing vs Technical Writing:** 
 Technical writing focuses on explaining complex
 



 processes, products, or instructions clearly, while content writing is aimed at engaging and
 



 informing readers through blogs, articles, or marketing material
 



 Technical writing is utilised across multiple industries including engineering, healthcare, science,
 



 and technology.
 



  





**Types of User guides** 
 \- Hardware Manuals, Software Manuals, API docs, SDK docs,
 



 Integration guides,
 



  





 Some user guide examples:
 



 https://developer.salesforce.com/docs\#browse
 



 docs.capillarytech.com
 



  





**Career Path:** 




 The demand for technical writers is closely linked to advancements in technology and the need
 



 for clear communication.
 



 The demand for technical writers is expected to remain strong, with projections indicating a
 



 growth rate of about 4% \- 7 % from 2023 to 2033\.
 



  





**Ideal for:** 
 Candidates who like to explore complicated applications and then explain it using
 



 simple English.
 



  





**Career Progress:** 
 Associate Technical Writer \> Senior Technical Writer \> Lead Technical Writer
 



 \> Manager \> Director of Technical Documentation
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 ● Understand products and services deeply to simplify complex technical concepts to
 



 create user\-friendly documentation.
 



 ● Attend demos, review Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and technical materials,
 



 and write clear explanations of features.
 



 ● Test APIs, document their functionality and explain the API parameters in a standard
 



 format.
 



 ● Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and
 



 engineers.
 



 ● Collaborate with Product Managers and assist in research and development
 



  





**Expertise and Qualifications** 




**Education:** 




 ● Bachelor’s degree in Technology or Arts.
 



  





**Skills:** 




 ● Ability to quickly learn and explain technical concepts like APIs, SDKs, and integrations.
 



 ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail.
 



 ● Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
 



 ● Interest in researching various topics and gathering information to create high\-quality
 



 documentation.

title: Associate Demo Engineer
description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com.
   

  

 Yext is looking for a curious, technology\-minded individual to join the Demo Engineering team as an
 **Associate Demo Engineer** 
 .
   

  

 This is a brilliant entry\-level opportunity for someone who is enthusiastic about technology, excited to learn, and keen to build a career at the intersection of AI, digital search, and sales enablement.The Demo Engineering team supports a wide range of internal partners — including Revenue (Sales and Solutions Engineering), Client Services, Marketing, and Product — by creating everything from polished standard demo environments to visionary "art of the possible" solutions that showcase what the Yext platform can do.
   

  

 As an Associate, you'll learn the craft of demo engineering from the ground up, working alongside experienced engineers and solutions professionals in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
   

  

 This role is based in India and is designed to give you real, hands\-on experience from day one — with clear development pathways into a full Demo Engineer role.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Supporting Demo Asset Creation, Development \& Deliverables**
* Support Senior Demo Engineers with delivering Demo Engineering requests. This will include assisting in building and maintaining standard demo environments using the Yext platform.
* Help customise demo accounts to reflect prospect\-specific use cases and industry contexts, guided by senior team members.
* Support updates to Knowledge Graph data, basic connector and crawler configurations, and front\-end elements.
* Help keep demo environments current with the latest Yext product features and configurations.


**Continuous Platform Learning \& Assistance of Deliverables**
* Continuously learn the Yext platform including Hearsay. Build a strong foundational understanding of the Yext platform, covering Listings, Search, Pages, and Knowledge Graph.
* Shadow Senior Demo Engineers and Solutions Engineers to learn how demos are scoped, built, and used throughout the sales cycle.
* Complete recommended certifications and participate in product enablement programmes.
* Learn SEO best practices and assist in assessing prospects' digital presence using these best practices, beginning to identify areas for improvement.
* Learn to understand the common data structures required to successfully support the generation of Yext Scout Reports.
* Learn to interpret Yext Analytics including Yext Scout.
* Learn to understand Yext Knowledge Scans; to evaluate a prospect's presence across digital Listings, user Reviews, and optimised web Pages.
* With guidance from Senior Demo Engineers, learn to prepare and support reports and materials to enable pre\-sales discussions led by Yext Global Solutions Engineers.
* Begin developing basic skills in HTML, CSS, and using AI tools (such as LLMs) to assist with front\-end customisation tasks.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Support the deal cycle by managing and responding to inbound requests from Solutions Engineers and Account Executives via Jira.
* Participate in scoping calls and team stand\-ups to develop an understanding of how work is prioritised.
* Stay close to product updates — including pre\-GA features — through internal channels and product communications.
* Share learnings and observations with the team via Slack and team meetings.
* Contribute to the SE Confluence knowledge hub by documenting what you've learnt, edge case handling, and useful guides for others.


**Operational Excellence**
* Keep your assigned Jira Tickets Demo up to date.
* Maintain and take responsibility for your allocated areas of the Demo Library.
* Follow team administration hygiene and ticketing standards so requests are tracked, prioritised, and delivered consistently.
* Be curious: ask questions proactively and surface blockers early — no one is expected to figure everything out alone.


**What You Have**
* A desire to develop a career in a technical, digital, or SaaS\-related role — relevant internships, placements, or academic projects are very welcome.
* A degree or equivalent practical experience in Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field.
* A basic awareness of HTML and CSS, or a genuine eagerness to learn.
* Clear, confident communication skills — you can explain ideas simply and work well with others.
* Genuine curiosity about technology, AI, and digital experiences.
* A coachable attitude and the motivation to grow quickly in a high\-performance environment
* The ability to manage multiple tasks and collaborate across teams effectively.
* Curiosity; the default mindset to want to understand why technical aspects work, behave, evolve and the value it brings to Yext clients.


**Bonus Points**
* Previous experience in a technical, digital, or SaaS\-related role.
* Any exposure to SaaS platforms, CMS tools, Analytics platforms or digital marketing and SEO concepts.
* A passing familiarity with JavaScript or basic front\-end development.
* Some experience or interest in data, structured content, or database concepts.
* An interest in how technology supports pre\-sales and revenue teams.


**Why You’ll Love It Here**
* You'll work at the forefront of AI and digital search technology, gaining practical experience in one of the fastest\-evolving spaces in tech.
* You'll build real demo assets that directly support enterprise sales cycles — your work will matter from the start.
* You'll receive structured mentorship and development to help you grow into a full Demo Engineer role.

 Node.js, TypeScript, React, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS.
 



**What you'd actually do** 



* Work across the full surface — product research, design, database architecture, back\-end, front\-end, QA, deployment, and SRE — not just one layer of it
* Take a spec, break it into workstreams an agent can execute in parallel, and run them
* Verify output — know what to trust, what to check by hand, what to throw away
* Escalate when the agent is confidently wrong
 *(this is the skill we care most about)*
* Ship. Own the thing after it ships.



**Who this is for** 



* 1–3 years building real software (product company, startup, or services — we don't care which)
* You already use Claude Code, Cursor, or similar — not as a toy, as how you work
* You've thrown away code you wrote and didn't mourn it
* You're currently somewhere that restricts, discourages, or ridicules this way of working, and you're tired of it



 Strong CS fundamentals matter. Where you studied doesn't. If you're from an IIT/NIT and this describes you, great — but the filter is practice, not pedigree.
 



**Who this is not for** 



* People who want to be told exactly what to build
* People who need to write every line to feel ownership
* People who list "AI" as a skill but have never shipped with an agent



**Process** 




 Four steps, roughly ten days start to offer:
 


* Conversation with the CPTO (45 min). You show me how you work, I show you how I work. This filters harder than anything else.
* Spec\-to\-handoff exercise. We give you a real spec. You decompose it and run it.
* Debug\-with\-agent. Something's broken. Find it, with your agent, while we watch.
* Offer.



 No leetcode. No DSA rounds. No take\-home that takes a weekend.
 



**Working here** 




 This is an in\-office role, based out of our Jaipur office. We're not hiring remote for this one — you'll be working alongside the team, in person, day to day.
 



 You'd report to and work directly alongside the CPTO, who runs parallel agent streams on this codebase daily. You will not be the only person here who works this way, and you will not have to justify the workflow to anyone.
 



 The company is 15\+ years old and profitable, with a client base that renews. That's stability most places offering "AI\-native engineering" don't have.
 



**How to apply** 




 Send us something you built with an agent. A repo, a CLAUDE.md, a thread, a Loom — anything that shows how you actually work. A résumé alone tells us nothing we need to know.

title: Senior Manager- People Operations
description:
**COMPANY SUMMARY**
  

Irth Solutions is a PE\-backed global SaaS company and the leading platform for damage prevention and asset protection in the energy, utility, telecom, and media industries. With \~350 employees across the US, Canada, and India, we help clients protect critical infrastructure through intelligent software that powers the entire damage prevention lifecycle. We're a scaling company with a builder's mindset — and we're looking for people who thrive in that environment  

  

**JOB SUMMARY**
  

We're hiring Senior Manager\- People Operations to own the operational backbone of our People \& Culture function. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who has built and run people operations in complex, multi\-jurisdictional environments and knows what "good" looks like in payroll, benefits, and HRIS without needing it to be handed to them. This role is based in our Pune, India office and operates on US business hours to support our North American employee population. You'll lead a team of two direct reports and report directly to the Chief People \& Culture Officer. If you're looking for a role where you can build infrastructure that actually matters and see your impact in real time, this is it.

 **Requirements** **What You'll Own**  

**Payroll**  



* Own end\-to\-end US payroll processing (semi\-monthly) for \~300\+ employees across multiple states, with hands\-on accountability for accuracy, timeliness, and compliance.
* Manage Canadian payroll operations across multiple provinces, including Quebec — navigating jurisdiction\-specific deductions, tax filing, and regulatory requirements
* Partner with Finance on payroll accounting, GL reconciliation, and audit readiness
* Lead remediation and ongoing maintenance of multi\-state payroll tax registrations, including proactive identification and resolution of tax ID gaps in Rippling
* Stay current on federal, state/provincial, and local payroll compliance changes across all operating jurisdictions

**Benefits Administration**

* Own US benefits program design and administration, including medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, 401(k), life, and ancillary lines
* Manage open enrollment end\-to\-end — plan selection, carrier coordination, employee communications, and system configuration in Rippling
* Lead broker relationship and serve as the primary point of contact for carriers and TPAs
* Ensure ACA compliance, reporting, and filing (1094/1095\-C)
* Support Canada benefits strategy in partnership with local HR resources (Pune/India ancillary benefits as applicable)

**HRIS — Rippling**

* Serve as the system owner and subject matter expert for Rippling across all modules: payroll, benefits, PTO, headcount, and integrations
* Own data integrity, configuration, workflows, and role\-based access
* Lead HRIS optimization initiatives — building automation, improving self\-service, and reducing manual lift across the People team
* Manage Rippling\-to\-Intacct integration, including issue escalation and resolution with vendor support
* Partner with Finance and IT on system governance, data validation, and new module rollouts

**People Operations \& Compliance**

* Directly manage and develop two People Operations team members — setting priorities, building capability, and creating a high\-performing team culture
* Develop and maintain HR policies across US and Canada jurisdictions, ensuring alignment with applicable employment law
* Support BYOD compliance framework, records retention, and HR audit readiness across US, Canada, and India •
* Manage unemployment claims, leave administration (FMLA, state leaves, parental), and workers' compensation programs
* Comfortable working US business hours from Pune — this is a firm requirement given the payroll and benefits support model for our North American workforce

**What You Bring**


* 7\+ years in People Operations, HR Operations, or a directly equivalent function — with demonstrated ownership of payroll and benefits, not just advisory support
* Prior experience managing direct reports with a track record of developing team members and driving accountability
* Hands\-on payroll processing experience in both the US (multi\-state) and Canada (multi province) — this is a hard requirement
* Deep Rippling expertise; you can configure it, troubleshoot it, and train others on it
* Strong knowledge of US payroll tax compliance, benefits regulations (ACA, ERISA, COBRA), and Canadian payroll and employment standards
* Familiarity with Quebec\-specific requirements (Law 25, CNESST, provincial payroll nuances) is a meaningful plus •
* Experience operating in a PE\-backed, high\-growth, or scaling SaaS environment — you know how to move fast with evolving structure
* Exceptional attention to detail combined with an ability to zoom out and see the system level picture
* Strong cross\-functional communication skills — you can translate payroll and compliance complexity for Finance, Legal, and executive stakeholders
* A builder's mentality: you identify gaps, propose solutions, and execute without waiting for someone to hand you a playbook

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with India\-based payroll or HR coordination (particularly in Pune/Maharashtra)
* Familiarity with SR\&ED tax credits or other Canadian R\&D incentive programs
* CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) or equivalent certification
* Experience with equity/stock plan administration or MIP/bonus program operationalization
* Prior experience managing an RPO or staffing partner relationship

**EDUCATION**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance/Accounting, or a related field.

  

**Benefits**  

  

What We Offer* Be part of a dynamic and growing company that is well\-respected in its industry.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
* Health Insurance coverage.

* Monitor marketplace trends, competitors, pricing and client demand.

* Maintain records of leads, proposals, conversations, conversions, revenue and follow\-ups.
* Coordinate internally to collect suitable portfolios, credentials, case studies and service descriptions.
* Ensure all communications maintain the confidentiality and professional standards expected from legal and corporate service providers.
* Provide structured monthly reports on marketplace performance, leads, conversions, revenue and recommended improvements.

title: Senior Manager- People Operations
description:
**Company Summary**
 Irth Solutions is a PE\-backed global SaaS company and the leading platform for damage prevention and asset protection in the energy, utility, telecom, and media industries. With :350 employees across the US, Canada, and India, we help clients protect critical infrastructure through intelligent software that powers the entire damage prevention lifecycle. We're a scaling company with a builder's mindset — and we're looking for people who thrive in that environment
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We're hiring Senior Manager\- People Operations to own the operational backbone of our People \& Culture function. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who has built and run people operations in complex, multi\-jurisdictional environments and knows what "good" looks like in payroll, benefits, and HRIS without needing it to be handed to them. This role is based in our Pune, India office and operates on US business hours to support our North American employee population. You'll lead a team of two direct reports and report directly to the Chief People \& Culture Officer. If you're looking for a role where you can build infrastructure that actually matters and see your impact in real time, this is it.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What You'll Own**
**Payroll**
* Own end\-to\-end US payroll processing (semi\-monthly) for :300\+ employees across multiple states, with hands\-on accountability for accuracy, timeliness, and compliance
* Manage Canadian payroll operations across multiple provinces, including Quebec — navigating jurisdiction\-specific deductions, tax filing, and regulatory requirements
* Partner with Finance on payroll accounting, GL reconciliation, and audit readiness
* Lead remediation and ongoing maintenance of multi\-state payroll tax registrations, including proactive identification and resolution of tax ID gaps in Rippling
* Stay current on federal, state/provincial, and local payroll compliance changes across all operating jurisdictions


**Benefits Administration**
* Own US benefits program design and administration, including medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, 401(k), life, and ancillary lines
* Manage open enrollment end\-to\-end — plan selection, carrier coordination, employee communications, and system configuration in Rippling
* Lead broker relationship and serve as the primary point of contact for carriers and TPAs
* Ensure ACA compliance, reporting, and filing (1094/1095\-C)
* Support Canada benefits strategy in partnership with local HR resources (Pune/India ancillary benefits as applicable)


**HRIS — Rippling**
* Serve as the system owner and subject matter expert for Rippling across all modules: payroll, benefits, PTO, headcount, and integrations
* Own data integrity, configuration, workflows, and role\-based access
* Lead HRIS optimization initiatives — building automation, improving self\-service, and reducing manual lift across the People team
* Manage Rippling\-to\-Intacct integration, including issue escalation and resolution with vendor support
* Partner with Finance and IT on system governance, data validation, and new module rollouts


**People Operations \& Compliance**
* Directly manage and develop two People Operations team members — setting priorities, building capability, and creating a high\-performing team culture
* Develop and maintain HR policies across US and Canada jurisdictions, ensuring alignment with applicable employment law
* Support BYOD compliance framework, records retention, and HR audit readiness across US, Canada, and India
* Manage unemployment claims, leave administration (FMLA, state leaves, parental), and workers' compensation programs
* Comfortable working US business hours from Pune — this is a firm requirement given the payroll and benefits support model for our North American workforce


**What You Bring**
* 7\+ years in People Operations, HR Operations, or a directly equivalent function — with demonstrated ownership of payroll and benefits, not just advisory support
* Prior experience managing direct reports with a track record of developing team members and driving accountability
* Hands\-on payroll processing experience in both the US (multi\-state) and Canada (multi province) — this is a hard requirement
* Deep Rippling expertise; you can configure it, troubleshoot it, and train others on it
* Strong knowledge of US payroll tax compliance, benefits regulations (ACA, ERISA, COBRA), and Canadian payroll and employment standards
* Familiarity with Quebec\-specific requirements (Law 25, CNESST, provincial payroll nuances) is a meaningful plus
* Experience operating in a PE\-backed, high\-growth, or scaling SaaS environment — you know how to move fast with evolving structure
* Exceptional attention to detail combined with an ability to zoom out and see the system level picture
* Strong cross\-functional communication skills — you can translate payroll and compliance complexity for Finance, Legal, and executive stakeholders
* A builder's mentality: you identify gaps, propose solutions, and execute without waiting for someone to hand you a playbook


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with India\-based payroll or HR coordination (particularly in Pune/Maharashtra)
* Familiarity with SR\&ED tax credits or other Canadian R\&D incentive programs
* CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) or equivalent certification
* Experience with equity/stock plan administration or MIP/bonus program operationalization
* Prior experience managing an RPO or staffing partner relationship


**EDUCATION**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance/Accounting, or a related field


**Benefits**
**What We Offer**
* Be part of a dynamic and growing company that is well\-respected in its industry
* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications
* Health Insurance coverage

title: Lead HR / Head of HR
description:
We are seeking a strategic and hands\-on HR Lead to oversee our human resources department and support our growing team of 200 employees.
 



  





 In this role, you will bridge the gap between business strategy and HR execution, managing everything from talent acquisition and employee relations to compliance, performance management, and culture building.
 



  





 As the primary HR leader, you will design scalable HR processes, coach managers, and ensure our workplace remains compliant, engaging, and high\-performing.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Strategic HR \& Scaling:** 




 \- Align HR initiatives with overall business goals to support organizational growth.
 



  





 \- Develop and scale HR policies, employee handbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
 



  





 \- Analyze HR metrics (e.g., turnover rates, time\-to\-hire, employee satisfaction) to guide leadership decisions.
 



  





**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding:** 




 \- Oversee the recruitment lifecycle to meet changing headcount needs efficiently.
 



  





 \- Optimize the onboarding process to ensure new hires integrate smoothly and reach productivity quickly.
 



  





 \- Build an employer brand that attracts top\-tier talent in our industry.
 



  





**Employee Relations \& Culture:** 




 \- Act as a trusted advisor to employees and managers, resolving complex interpersonal conflicts and grievances.
 



  





 \- Design engagement programs that maintain a strong, inclusive corporate culture across a 200\-person footprint.
 



  





 \- Conduct exit interviews and translate feedback into actionable retention strategies.
 



  





**Performance Management \& Development:** 




 \- Lead the annual performance review process, ensuring fair, clear, and constructive feedback cycles.
 



  





 \- Coach department managers on leadership styles, team management, and handling difficult conversations.
 



  





 \- Identify training needs and implement learning and development (L\&D) programs.
 



  





**Compensation, Benefits \& Compliance:** 




 \- Partner with finance/payroll to ensure accurate compensation administration and competitive benchmarking.
 



  





 \- Oversee health benefits, wellness programs, and perks administration.
 



  





 \- Ensure strict compliance with local, state, and federal labor laws to mitigate organizational risk.
 



  





**Required Qualifications:** 




**Experience:** 




 \- 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 2 years in a senior, lead, or standalone HR manager role.
 



  





**Company Scale:** 




 \- Proven track record working in companies of 150 \- 300 employees (understanding the unique challenges of mid\-sized scaling).
 



  





**Education:** 




 \- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (SHRM\-CP/SCP or PHR/SPHR certification is a strong plus).
 



  





**Tech Savvy:** 




 \- High proficiency with HRIS platforms (e.g., BambooHR, Rippling, Gusto), ATS software (e.g., Greenhouse, Lever), and data analytics tools.
 



  





**Core Competencies:** 




 \- Emotional Intelligence: Strong empathy balanced with objective, professional judgment.
 



  





 \- Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills for interfacing with both entry\-level staff and C\-suite executives.
 



  





 \- Problem\-Solving: Ability to navigate ambiguity and resolve complex personnel issues independently.

Access, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement Process assigned user\-access and exception requests and validate that report access is limited to approved business scope and user personas. Follow approved development, release, access\-control, documentation, and data\-handling processes. Identify opportunities to improve dashboard performance, simplify recurring operations, strengthen controls, and automate repeatable validation or refresh activities. Cross\-Functional Collaboration Partner with Field Effectiveness, Incentive Compensation, analytics, iDNA/data\-management, cross\-system operations, and field stakeholders to deliver end\-to\-end reporting changes. Coordinate data dependencies, UAT readiness, feedback, and production\-release activities with business and technical partners. Communicate progress, decisions, risks, and support needs clearly to stakeholders across geographies and levels. What we expect of you We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. Basic Qualifications Master's degree or Bachelor's degree and 1 \- 3 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, dashboard development, commercial reporting, and/or sales operations. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the bio/pharmaceutical or healthcare industry. Hands\-on experience developing and supporting Tableau dashboards; exposure to enterprise reporting portals is preferred. Ability to write SQL queries, assess data requirements, reconcile outputs, and investigate data issues; familiarity with Databricks or comparable data platforms is helpful. Strong understanding of data visualization, dashboard usability, calculations, filters, geographic hierarchies, and role\-based access. Experience with commercial data such as sales, activity, targets, goals, customer/account, claims, and engagement data. Experience working in agile delivery models and using Jira or similar tools for backlog, sprint, issue, and release management. Strong quality\-control discipline, attention to detail, and ability to document testing evidence and communicate defects clearly. Effective written and verbal communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. What you can expect of us As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we'll support your journey every step of the way. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease. .

“Applying Knowledge”

About the Institution

The Sai Pali Institute of Technology and Management (SITM) is a premier academic institution in Kampala,

Uganda, dedicated to nurturing elite tech talent. Our ultimate goal is student transformation — producing

high\-quality software engineers ready for the global market. We are seeking an exceptionally capable and

energetic Technical Trainer from India to anchor our Diploma in Software Development and Engineering, where

you will directly shape the next generation of African tech talent.

Why Uganda? Why This Role?

* An escape from the grind, without leaving your career behind. Skip the three\-hour commutes, crowded metros,

and endless competition for the same desk job. In Kampala you will find the space — mental and physical — to actually

build things.

* Build from zero, not from a backlog. This is not a maintenance role in a 10,000\-person company. You will design

curricula, shape programmes, and leave a visible mark. Your work is the institution.

* A life upgrade, honestly priced. Low cost of living, furnished accommodation provided, and a salary that lets you

save meaningfully — increasingly rare in Indian metros.

* Africa is the next frontier. East Africa experience is rare on an Indian CV and highly valued by global companies,

ed\-tech firms, and international organisations. You will return with a story no classroom in India can give you.

* The Pearl of Africa. Uganda is stable, welcoming, English\-speaking, and stunningly beautiful — from Lake Victoria to

Bwindi's forests. Weekends here look very different from weekends in a metro.

Compensation \& Benefits

* Salary: USD 700 – 1,000 per month, based on experience (1–3 years of teaching, training, or industry

mentorship).

* Accommodation: Comfortable, furnished living accommodation provided.
* Relocation: Full relocation assistance to Kampala, including airfare and settlement support.
* Work permit \& visa: Sponsored and processed by the Institute.
* Health cover: Medical insurance provided.
* Platform: A highly collaborative, resource\-rich academic environment to build your career in.

Who Thrives Here

You are 1–3 years into your tech or teaching career, tired of being one of five hundred applicants for the same role,

and hungry for real responsibility early. You are curious, energetic, and genuinely excited by the idea of living and

working in East Africa. You may be an industry fresher with a rich project portfolio and a natural gift for instruction

— we will consider passionate candidates seriously.

Critical Eligibility Criteria

* Teaching passion: We are strictly not looking for passive slide\-readers. You must possess a profound,

infectious passion for mentoring that inspires curiosity, commands a classroom, and pushes students to excel.

* Ability to learn and teach: Technology shifts constantly. You must be able to self\-master cutting\-edge tools,

libraries, and frameworks quickly and confidently deliver them in the classroom.

Applying Knowledge

Sai Pali Institute of Technology \& Management (SITM) — Sai Pali Group

Kampala Campus: Plot \#887, Block\-4, Bakuli, Mengo, Namirembe Road, opposite Victorious Primary School, Kampala, Uganda

interviews, preparing them explicitly for competitive international careers.

Required Technical Skills \& Qualifications

* Core programming: Solid coding and architectural foundations in Java and PHP.
* AI/ML expertise: Practical project experience in data preprocessing, supervised/unsupervised learning models,

and modern GenAI/LLM tools.

* Experience: 1–3 years of teaching, bootcamp training, or peer mentorship. Passionate industry freshers with

strong portfolios are welcome.

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Your Growth Path

Technical Trainer → Lead Trainer → Curriculum Head → Academic Director. Whether you stay and build SITM

into a regional powerhouse or return to India with rare international experience, this role compounds your career in

a way a conventional junior role cannot.

Life in Kampala — For You and Your Family

Kampala is a safe, established, English\-speaking city with a warm climate, a growing Indian community, and easy

weekend escapes — Lake Victoria, Jinja's Nile rapids, and Uganda's national parks. The campus is located in the

quiet Bakuli–Mengo neighbourhood, and the Institute provides secure, comfortable housing nearby.

Send your resume, a short note on why this role excites you, and links to your GitHub or portfolio to the SITM

**Position Summary**

The ideal candidate will be responsible for implementing and maintaining security measures that protect information systems, network infrastructure, and organizational data. This role involves vulnerability management, risk assessments, incident response, security architecture, and compliance activities to ensure a strong security posture across the organization.

* Develop and implement preventive security measures to strengthen security controls.
* Configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain security tools and infrastructure.
* Prepare security reports, dashboards, incident reports, and technical documentation for management and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and stakeholders to identify and address security risks.
* Support security awareness activities and provide cybersecurity guidance to employees and technical teams.
* Perform periodic reviews of security controls and recommend improvements across endpoint, network, application, cloud, and infrastructure environments.
* Participate in security investigations, root\-cause analysis, and post\-incident reviews to identify opportunities for improving security operations.

 Mandatory Technical Requirements
   

  

* 3–5 years of hands\-on SOC/SIEM experience.
* Mandatory hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure Defender.
* Mandatory hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure Sentinel.
* Strong experience in security incident handling and incident response.
* Experience monitoring and investigating security alerts, events, and logs.
* Strong understanding of Security Operations Center processes and SIEM\-based threat monitoring.
* Experience with vulnerability management and security risk assessments.
* Knowledge of Information Security, Cybersecurity, and Security Operations.
* Knowledge of security monitoring, threat detection, incident investigation, and remediation.
* Understanding of GRC and security frameworks, including HIPAA, HITECH, PCI, and NIST.
* Knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Unix operating systems.
* Understanding of security architecture and security controls.

* Experience with endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools.
* Experience with threat intelligence and security analytics.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Territory Service Representative: BLX
description:
**Job Title**

  

**Territory Service Representative – Operations**

  

  

**Function**

  

**Operations**

  

  

**Reports To**

  

Inbound Shift In\-charge / Outbound Shift In\-charge (as applicable)  



  

**Location**

  

**Mathura**

  

  

**Travel Required**

  

**25%** **50%** **75%** **þ**

  

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **8th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.
