Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
 





 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. Expert Client Delivery (ECD) is an integral unit of BCN. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutions across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence, and Bain intellectual property.
 




  






**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:**





  






 This is an opportunity to be part of Bain’s Capital Projects Center of Expertise (CoE), based out of the Gurugram office, specifically supporting Bain’s Capital Projects \& Infrastructure practice on live cases, client development and proposal support. The Capital Projects CoE works across major capital programs spanning energy, infrastructure, transport, oil \& gas, power \& utilities, mining and large industrial build\-outs.
 





 As part of the Capital Projects team, you will get exposed to case delivery and client development activities for clients executing large, complex capital programs. The primary objective is to collaborate with practice and case teams on the development and deployment of project\-controls, PMO and digital capabilities that answer strategic questions for Bain’s capital\-intensive clients — from project setup and assurance through delivery and turnaround.
 





 An Associate works as a team member / contributor on BCN cases, driving the analysis on complex cases with some direction from a Project Leader and occasionally leading simple cases independently. In addition, Associates help mentor and coach Analysts by providing regular guidance / feedback and progressively take on greater ownership of workstreams.
 








  




**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**






  
 



* **Day\-to\-day management of 2\-3 team members**


* Lead a small team of Analysts and Jr. Associates, owning day\-to\-day delivery with limited PL/Manager oversight
* Understand and translate the client's context and business problem into a clear, prioritized work plan
* Create the work plan, provide guidance to junior team members, and review outputs to ensure high\-quality delivery to clients
* Anticipate roadblocks, resolve them at source, and escalate early when needed


* **Program governance \& PMO operations**


* Design and stand up PMO operating models — stage\-gate governance, change control, RACI, decision logs, escalation paths — and assess the robustness of a client's existing setup
* Build and interrogate the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS): run critical\-path, what\-if, and schedule\-compression analyses that underpin recommendations


* **Cost \& performance controls**


* Build cost\-control and Earned Value analyses (budget phasing, CPI/SPI, forecast\-at\-completion, variance) to pinpoint where a program is over budget or behind schedule
* Create executive\-ready dashboards that give client leadership a decision\-grade view of project health


* **Risk \& safety management**


* Build the analytical backbone for risk reviews — risk registers, quantified mitigations, contingency strategies — and turn findings into recommendations the team can land with the client


* **Digital \& advanced analytics**


* Shape the digital roadmap and success metrics for client programs, including 5D BIM (cost \+ schedule) and model\-based quantity management
* Apply advanced scheduling and risk analytics — constraint\-based planning, scenario simulation, Monte Carlo — to quantify outcomes and de\-risk recommendations
* Build Power BI / Tableau control towers and pilot AI tools that speed delivery and leave the client with reusable assets



  






**ABOUT YOU:**











* Relevant experience of 2\-5 years for undergraduates and 0\-3 years for postgraduates from a top\-tier college with a strong academic record and 3\-4 years of relevant experience in capital projects, project controls, PMO or management consulting
* PMP® certification or active progress toward it is an advantage (not mandatory at this level)
* Hands\-on with at least 2–3 of: Project controls, P6/MS Project, Power BI/Tableau, BIM (Navisworks/Revit/Synchro), EVM, ALICE – Generative Scheduling, AI tools
* Strong analytical, MS Office, communication, problem\-solving, and team\-player skills; able to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure




  
 





**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**





  






 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: HR Manager - Global Businesses & Functions
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Reporting to the HR Director, Global Business \& Functions (GBF), you will act as a key HR
   

  

 Advisor to People Managers, their teams, and employees. You will primarily be the HR Advisor to
   

  

 assigned Business(s) / Function(s) in India region and will be part of a broader HR Advisory team
   

  

 supporting 1600\+ Global Services employees in the region.
   

  

 You will be responsible for providing HR Advice to senior management, people managers and teams on HR matters, working closely with the Global Services HR Business Partner \& Talent Partners for the assigned Business(s) / Function(s) to help drive the HR Strategy and managing the interplay between precise HR operations, stakeholder management, employee support and broader HR initiatives and projects.
   

  

 Operating as a key business advisor and subject matter expert with assigned business/ function(s) through business knowledge, relationship management and proactive interventions, this role is critical for creating a culture where our employees are valued members of BCG in the region and can manage their careers to meet their personal aspirations and drive outcomes in line with BCGs business objectives. This role requires extensive collaboration across the HR Business Partner, Talent partners, Core HR Delivery, Regional Partners, and Operational CoEs.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Preferred, 8\+ years of HR/People Advisory, consulting experience, or relevant experience in professional services environment strongly preferred
* M.B.A / Specialization in Human Resources, Organization Development or related field
* Be a strong and approachable HR generalist with deep understanding of local geography and legal requirements
* Depth of experience in HR practices, including performance and talent mgt., engagement, compensation, employee relations.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills, sound judgement and the ability to juggle many often competing priorities simultaneously.
* Able to perform successfully in a fast\-paced, intellectually intense, service\-oriented, and matrix\-structured environment and to interpret rules and guidelines flexibly
* Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills, and trust/credibility with the demonstrated ability to develop effective relationships at all levels of the organization
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, proven ability to diagnose problems and identify and drive appropriate solutions
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Detail oriented, organized with advanced project and process management skills
* Strong teaming, collaboration, and relationship skills
* Strong in excel, PowerPoint, and other digital products such as Workday.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You will be part of the Global Business \& Functions People team, working closely with HRBPs, Talent Partners, Core HR, Talent Acquisition, and global HR teams across India, North America, and Europe. You will support a diverse employee base across Business \& Functions in India.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**
* HR Advisory: Providing advice to management, their teams and employees on people related topics (career planning, performance management, coaching, compensation, legal risk mitigation/compliance, employee relations and learning and development). Developing and maintaining effective business relationships with functionally aligned client groups, the HR team and broader HR community
* Technical Expertise and coaching: You will coach employees and Managers on complex HR issues including Policies / Processes and People matters, and bring deep technical and local HR expertise and to support through the BCG employee lifecycle journey.
* Employee relations: Serving as the primary point of contact for employee relations your Business/ functions in the region, offering expert guidance and resolution strategies. End to end ownership of ER; resolving workplace conflict, managing grievances, effective communication, and fostering positive culture \& engagement.
* Compliance w/ employment laws \& regulations: ensuring organization follows all applicable employment laws \& regulations, keeping up to date with legal changes, and integrating these changes into HR practices and policies. First point of contact for employees and managers regarding HR policies and procedures ensuring appropriate communication and consistent application
* Performance management: assist in mgt of performance reviews \& processes, ensuring fairness, transparency \& compliance; End\-to\-end management of PIPs
* Training \& development: provide on the ground insights to HRBPs on development needs and lead design \& execution of locally led, in person, training
* Career Development: Support career development for our employees, including clarification of our career framework, creation and communication of learning and development opportunities to build capability and expertise including Line Manager coaching etc.
* Supporting key HR and People Processes: Ensures all HR processes related to Employee cycle (viz. year\-end reviews, comp cycles, organizational transformation, etc.), are seamlessly executed to the highest standards while being legally compliant
* Understanding business goals and market trends: leveraging insight to recommend and influence new approaches, policies and procedures to effect continual improvements in business objectives, productivity and development of HR.
* Drive continuous improvement: realize economies of scale and seek opportunities to leverage technology to create efficiencies.
* Key HR Initiatives: Participate and/ or lead where assigned, in projects or Key HR Initiatives collaborating across HR subfunctions or with stakeholders in other functions / businesses


 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Senior Manager – Human Resources & Talent Management
description:
Senior Manager – Human Resources \& Talent Management
 



**Company:** 
 Vsquare Systems Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
 Pune
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Work from Office
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 8–12 years preferred
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 Vsquare Systems is looking for an experienced
 **Senior Manager – Human Resources \& Talent Management** 
 to lead and actively manage the HR function as the organization enters its next phase of growth.
 



 This is a
 **hands\-on leadership role** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can think strategically, establish processes, lead the HR/recruitment team and advise Leadership, while also being willing and capable of personally executing critical HR activities when required.
 



 The role will cover
 **Talent Acquisition, Workforce Planning, Employee Lifecycle Management, Performance Management, Employee Engagement, Technical Training \& Capability Development, HR Operations, Compliance, HR Analytics and People Governance** 
 .
 



 The successful candidate should be comfortable moving between:
 



**Planning → Execution → Tracking → Problem Solving → Management Reporting** 




 The role requires a strong understanding of an
 **IT services and technology consulting business** 
 , where people capability, niche technology hiring, customer requirements, project deployment, utilization and retention directly influence business performance.
 



 This is a
 **Work from Office role based in Pune** 
 requiring active interaction with Leadership, Delivery teams and employees.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. HR Leadership \& Hands\-on Ownership
 



 Take ownership of the overall HR function while remaining actively involved in execution.
 


* Understand Vsquare’s business priorities and translate them into HR and workforce priorities.
* Review existing HR processes and identify areas requiring improvement.
* Establish practical and scalable HR processes, policies and operating mechanisms.
* Lead and guide the existing HR/recruitment team.
* Define responsibilities, targets and performance expectations for the HR team.
* Personally intervene and execute activities where the requirement is critical or requires senior HR involvement.
* Establish appropriate HR systems, data structures and reporting.
* Work directly with Company Leadership and Delivery Management.
* Proactively identify people, hiring, capability and retention risks and drive them to closure.
* Ensure that HR initiatives move from discussion to actual implementation.



 The role requires a
 **player\-coach mindset** 
 — someone who leads the function but remains close to execution.
 



 2\. Talent Acquisition
 



 Own and actively participate in the complete recruitment lifecycle.
 


* Understand manpower requirements directly from Delivery, Sales and Leadership teams.
* Develop hiring plans for current and anticipated requirements.
* Personally drive critical, niche and leadership hiring where required.
* Convert technical requirements into effective job descriptions and sourcing strategies.
* Source candidates directly where appropriate rather than depending entirely on recruiters or agencies.
* Build talent pipelines for technology skills including:
* Databricks / Data Engineering
* Azure / AWS / GCP
* Ab Initio
* SAP
* AI / GenAI
* UI/UX and Application Development
* Conduct HR screening for important positions and establish screening standards for the recruitment team.
* Validate candidate experience, technical relevance, communication, compensation, notice period, location and joining feasibility.
* Coordinate and actively follow technical and customer interview processes.
* Personally handle critical compensation discussions and offer negotiations.
* Maintain engagement with selected candidates through joining.
* Improve offer\-to\-joining conversion.
* Build and maintain a structured and searchable candidate database.
* Ensure historical candidate data is reviewed, cleaned and effectively reused.
* Build and manage recruitment partners.
* Measure recruitment funnel effectiveness and recruiter productivity.
* Continuously improve hiring quality and turnaround time.



 The Senior Manager will be accountable not merely for managing recruiters but for
 **delivering hiring outcomes** 
 .
 



 3\. Workforce \& Resource Planning
 



 Work directly with Delivery and Leadership to maintain forward\-looking workforce visibility.
 


* Maintain visibility of billable, non\-billable and bench resources.
* Track upcoming project roll\-offs and resource availability.
* Identify internal deployment opportunities before initiating external hiring.
* Maintain organization\-wide skill inventory and employee competency information.
* Forecast workforce requirements based on confirmed projects and business pipeline.
* Translate business demand into hiring and capability\-development plans.
* Identify resource gaps and hiring risks proactively.
* Support rapid ramp\-up requirements for new customers/projects.
* Provide Leadership with forward\-looking workforce visibility.



 4\. Employee Lifecycle Management
 



 Own and actively oversee HR activities across the complete employee lifecycle:
 



**Joining → Onboarding → Employment → Performance → Development → Retention → Separation** 




 Responsibilities include:
 


* Offer and appointment documentation
* Background verification
* Joining formalities
* Employee documentation
* Induction and onboarding
* Probation and confirmation
* Employee transfers and role changes
* Performance\-review coordination
* Promotion and compensation changes
* Employee grievances
* Retention interventions
* Resignation and exit processes
* Exit interviews
* Full \& Final settlement coordination
* Experience and relieving documentation



 Personally handle sensitive or important employee matters where senior HR involvement is required.
 



 5\. Employee Engagement \& Retention
 



 Lead and actively participate in employee engagement initiatives.
 


* Establish an annual and quarterly Employee Engagement Calendar.
* Conduct regular employee connect sessions.
* Personally interact with employees across teams to understand concerns and feedback.
* Identify employee concerns and potential attrition risks early.
* Establish recognition and reward initiatives.
* Lead the organization of company events, celebrations and team\-building activities.
* Coordinate employee participation and communication.
* Measure effectiveness of engagement initiatives.
* Work with managers to improve employee experience and retention.



 The expectation is to
 **personally drive important engagement initiatives** 
 , not simply assign event execution to others.
 



 6\. External Technology \& Professional Events
 



 Lead and actively coordinate external technology and professional events involving Vsquare.
 



 These may include:
 


* Technology meetups
* Knowledge\-sharing forums
* Customer/partner technology events
* Industry events and conferences
* Hackathons
* Technical workshops
* Campus events
* Recruitment events



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Event planning and execution
* Coordination with Leadership and Technology Leads
* Speaker and participant coordination
* Employee participation
* External partner/vendor coordination
* Venue and logistics
* Event communication
* Employer branding and talent outreach



 The Senior Manager should be comfortable
 **personally coordinating important events from planning through execution** 
 .
 



 7\. Technical Training \& Capability Development
 



 Lead the establishment and day\-to\-day management of a structured
 **Technical Training and Capability Development Program** 
 .
 


* Work directly with Delivery and Technology Leads to identify current and future skill requirements.
* Conduct skill\-gap analysis.
* Develop annual and quarterly technical training plans.
* Identify internal SMEs, external trainers and technology partners.
* Personally coordinate the setup and execution of training programs.
* Organize technical workshops and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Establish certification programs.
* Follow up with employees on training and certification commitments.
* Track attendance, completion, assessments and certifications.
* Measure effectiveness of training programs.
* Maintain employee skill and certification records.
* Build and maintain organization\-wide competency and skill matrices.
* Support cross\-skilling and upskilling.
* Establish learning paths for strategic technologies such as Databricks, GCP, Ab Initio, SAP, AI/GenAI and emerging technologies.
* Establish appropriate training/onboarding programs for freshers and lateral hires.
* Connect training plans with upcoming project and business demand.



 HR will own
 **planning, coordination, execution, tracking and measurement** 
 , while Technology and Delivery Leads will provide technical direction and subject\-matter expertise.
 



 8\. Performance Management
 



 Establish and operate a practical performance\-management framework.
 


* Establish employee goals/KRAs.
* Coordinate and actively follow up on periodic performance reviews.
* Ensure timely completion of appraisals.
* Improve quality and consistency of performance feedback.
* Maintain appropriate performance documentation.
* Support promotion and increment processes.
* Identify high performers and employees requiring development.
* Coordinate Performance Improvement Plans where required.
* Connect performance management with training, career development and recognition.



 9\. HR Operations \& Compliance
 



 Ensure disciplined execution of HR administration and compliance.
 


* Maintain accurate employee master data and personnel records.
* Manage attendance and leave processes.
* Coordinate payroll inputs with Finance.
* Maintain compensation and benefits information.
* Support PF, ESIC, gratuity, POSH and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain HR policies and employee handbook.
* Ensure confidentiality of employee and compensation information.
* Maintain appropriate HR documentation and audit readiness.
* Periodically verify that defined HR processes are actually being followed.



 10\. HR Technology, Data \& Process Improvement
 



 Establish a structured and data\-driven HR operating environment.
 


* Create a reliable single source of HR and recruitment information.
* Improve the quality and usability of existing HR and recruitment data.
* Ensure historical candidate information is organized and searchable.
* Effectively utilize HRMS/ATS and other appropriate HR technology.
* Reduce unnecessary spreadsheet and manual\-process dependency.
* Digitize and automate recurring HR processes where appropriate.
* Establish data ownership and data\-quality standards.
* Personally drive implementation of key HR process improvements rather than limiting involvement to recommendations.



 11\. HR MIS \& Management Reporting
 



 Own the preparation, validation and interpretation of HR management information.
 



 Reporting should include:
 


* Total headcount
* Billable / non\-billable / bench headcount
* Open positions
* Hiring demand vs capacity
* Candidate pipeline
* Recruitment funnel
* Time\-to\-hire
* Offer\-to\-joining ratio
* Recruitment source effectiveness
* Recruiter productivity
* Attrition
* Upcoming project roll\-offs
* Upcoming confirmations
* Skill distribution
* Certification status
* Training plans and completion
* Employee engagement activities
* Leave / attendance exceptions
* Workforce forecast
* Key HR risks and required actions



 The Senior Manager should be sufficiently close to the underlying information to
 **validate and explain the numbers personally** 
 , rather than relying solely on reports prepared by the team.
 



 Management reporting should clearly answer:
 



**What is happening? Why is it happening? What is at risk? What action is being taken? What decision/support is required from Leadership?** 




 Candidate Profile
 



 The ideal candidate should have:
 


* **8–12 years of progressive HR experience** 
 , preferably within IT services, technology consulting, digital engineering, data/cloud services or a similar organization.
* Experience leading HR/recruitment responsibilities while remaining hands\-on.
* Strong hands\-on IT Talent Acquisition experience.
* Demonstrated experience personally sourcing and closing technology positions.
* Experience managing or mentoring recruiters/HR team members.
* Experience building recruitment capability for organizational growth.
* Good understanding of technology roles and skills.
* Experience with workforce planning and resource\-demand forecasting.
* Strong understanding of employee lifecycle management.
* Experience establishing or improving HR processes.
* Experience organizing employee engagement initiatives and corporate events.
* Experience setting up and coordinating technical training and certification programs.
* Experience working directly with senior leadership.
* Working knowledge of Indian employment practices and statutory HR requirements.
* Strong communication, stakeholder\-management and negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
* Experience with HRMS/ATS systems and HR process automation.



 Critical Competencies
 



 Hands\-on Leadership
 



 Leads people while remaining willing and able to personally execute important activities.
 



 Ownership
 



 Takes responsibility from requirement through closure rather than limiting the role to coordination or delegation.
 



 Business Orientation
 



 Understands the relationship between people, skills, utilization, project delivery, revenue and customer commitments.
 



 Talent Judgement
 



 Can personally evaluate candidate relevance and establish appropriate screening standards for the recruitment team.
 



 Execution Discipline
 



 Converts discussions and plans into measurable actions with owners, timelines and outcomes.
 



 Technology Orientation
 



 Understands technology roles, skills and certifications sufficiently to operate effectively in a technology consulting organization.
 



 Data Orientation
 



 Uses structured data and metrics to manage HR and can personally explain the underlying numbers.
 



 Employee Maturity
 



 Handles sensitive employee matters with judgement, confidentiality and professionalism.
 



 Problem Solving
 



 Identifies gaps, proposes practical solutions and follows implementation through completion.
 



 Success Measures
 



 Performance will be measured through:
 


* Quality and turnaround time of hiring
* Closure of critical and niche technology positions
* Recruitment funnel effectiveness
* Reduction in irrelevant profiles reaching technical interviews
* Offer\-to\-joining conversion
* Workforce readiness against business requirements
* Employee retention and attrition management
* Accuracy of HR and recruitment data
* Bench/resource visibility
* Technical training and certification progress
* Employee engagement effectiveness
* Successful execution of internal and external events
* HR process compliance
* Quality and timeliness of HR MIS
* Effectiveness of the HR/recruitment team
* Responsiveness and closure of employee issues
* Successful implementation of HR process improvements
* Ability to anticipate people and capability risks before they become business escalations



 Reporting \& Collaboration
 



 The
 **Senior Manager – Human Resources \& Talent Management** 
 will work closely with
 **Company Leadership and Delivery Management** 
 and will take end\-to\-end ownership of HR and Talent Management activities.
 



 The role will collaborate closely with Delivery, Technology Leads, Finance, Administration, Sales/Marketing and external partners.
 



 This role requires someone who is equally comfortable
 **leading a management discussion, interviewing a critical candidate, resolving an employee issue, reviewing recruitment data, coordinating a technical training program or personally driving an important organizational event** 
 .

**Position Summary**

This role requires a strong analytical mindset and technical expertise to work with large datasets, derive insights, and deliver value to stakeholders as well as product management and development experience. The Product Analyst combines operational, technical, and analytic skills with problem\-solving and communication abilities. You will collaborate with and work closely with Senior Data Analyst and/or Product Owner(s) to ensure successful project execution.
   

  

**Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:**
* Operational Execution:
+ Understand and communicate client business needs and issues, operating rules, data structures, and standard operating procedures.
+ Execute and suggest improvements to pre\-defined operational procedures.
+ Implement process improvement in operational workflows, working with Senior Data Analysts and Product Owners.
+ Assist Product Owners to streamline the ideas to development processes, and the technical requirements processes.

* Product Development:
+ Enhance and maintain data products by understanding the data, product(s)/offering(s), client needs, and business goals.
+ Collaborate with stakeholders regarding business objectives.
+ Support product management with product development, and execution.
+ Partner with Product management to create, maintain and update roadmap documentation
+ Assist teams towards common objectives and document the solutions/decisions made.
+ Create technical requirements, user stories and test plans as part of an Agile methodological approach.


* Data Analysis:
+ Compare datasets / various inputs to ensure data quality and derive actionable insights.
+ Apply quality checks and validations to the product delivery, reporting results and elaborative summary for internal team and important stakeholders.

* Stakeholder collaboration:

+ Facilitate knowledge transfer and overall product knowledge for engineering, Engagement and other teams.
+ Partner with stakeholders e.g. Engagement and Product Owners to understand client business needs and pain points with the intention to write user stories that address those needs.
+ Work closely with product team: Owners, developers and testers to ensure that written requirements are clearly stated, and comprehensive.

* Knowledge development:
+ Build subject matter expertise in operational processes, data tools, content, and necessary technology, and Scrum / Agile methodologies
+ Remain updated on tools, techniques, and working models to enhance processes.
+ Develop functional understanding of the product offering via the technology and deployment stack, to facilitate writing effective user stories, requirements and user acceptance criteria.


* Project Management:
+ Work on multiple client tasks simultaneously, strengthening analytical, task management, and communication skills.
+ Keep track of unplanned internal and clients’ tasks arising from any developments to existing or new products.
+ Maximize time management skills to balance workload in order to complete multiple deadline driven projects with a minimum of supervisory input.

* Coordinate meetings and prepare status update documentation / meetings for ongoing projects Research and Problem\-Solving

+ Coordinate and co lead design sessions to document feature requirements and guide stakeholders towards decision\-making.
+ Investigate issues and recommend solutions to improve processes.

 \-

* Detail orientation with a strong focus on quality, analytics, and operations.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals, Managed Markets Consulting or Analytics Consulting with broad based experience in, managed care, and/or analytics will be an advantage.
* Proven ability to work with global teams across different time\-zones.


**Preferred**
* Masters in these disciplines OR MBA/PGDM/Equivalent

* Strong knowledge of US Healthcare, payer/provider datasets, and managed care analytics.

title: AI engineering intern - custom models & multi-model memory
description:
This is a founding engineer offer with a stipend of Rs 20,000 with a possibility for an incentive of Rs 5,000 every bi\-weekly depending on the performance. Internship will be converted into founding engineer role which comes with equity.
 



  





 Recollia builds AI tools for medical students. Our responses run on Claude and OpenAI today. We're replacing most of that with our own fine\-tuned models, and building RAV, a unified\-memory layer that works across Claude, ChatGPT, open\-weight models, and our internal tools. You'll work on both, inside the architecture, not on the edges of it.
 



  





 WHAT YOU'LL BUILD
 



 • Fine\-tuning pipelines: data prep, SFT and LoRA/QLoRA on open\-weight models, evals that prove the model got better
 



 • Inference serving, measured on cost per response against the API baseline
 



 • RAV's memory layer and a model gateway that routes across providers with fallbacks
 



  





 REQUIRED
 



  





 Model training
 



 • Transformer internals well enough to reason about them: attention, KV cache, tokenization, chat templates, context\-length trade\-offs
 



 • Fine\-tuning beyond the tutorial: SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, preference tuning (DPO or similar), and when each is the wrong tool
 



 • Training mechanics: mixed precision, gradient accumulation and checkpointing, LR schedules, multi\-GPU (FSDP/DeepSpeed), and the memory math to know what fits on a given card
 



 • Dataset work: cleaning, dedup, formatting, synthetic data generation, and recognizing when the data is the problem rather than the model
 



 • Evaluation: held\-out eval sets, LLM\-as\-judge and its failure modes, regression suites; a loss curve alone doesn't convince you
 



  





 Inference and serving
 



 • Serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, llama.cpp): continuous batching, KV\-cache management, what actually drives throughput
 



 • Quantization (AWQ, GPTQ, GGUF, FP8\) and measuring the quality you lose
 



 • Profiling: TTFT, tokens/sec, p95 latency, cost per response against an API baseline
 



 • GPU cloud deploys (RunPod, Modal, Lambda, AWS) with Docker; autoscaling and cold starts
 



  





 Memory and retrieval
 



 • Embedding models: selection, evaluation, domain fine\-tuning
 



 • Retrieval pipelines: chunking, hybrid search (BM25 \+ dense), rerankers, metadata filtering, query rewriting; measured with recall@k, not vibes
 



 • Memory design: episodic vs. semantic memory, compaction, write policies, staleness and conflict resolution, entity or graph memory
 



 • Vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, LanceDB) and Postgres well enough to design schemas and indexes
 



  





 Multi\-model orchestration
 



 • Provider\-agnostic gateway across Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenAI\-compatible open\-weight endpoints: routing by cost, quality, and latency; fallbacks, retries, rate limits, streaming
 



 • Structured outputs and tool calling across providers, including where they differ
 



 • Agent loops, MCP servers and clients, connector ingestion via OAuth APIs (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, GitHub, Linear, Notion)
 



 • Observability: tracing (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry), token accounting, cost dashboards
 



 • Prompt injection and PII risk in connector\-fed systems, and how to contain it
 



  





 Engineering foundations
 



 • Python at library level, not script level: async, typing, packaging, profiling; you've read transformers or vLLM source when the docs ran out
 



 • FastAPI or equivalent, Postgres, Redis, Docker, Linux, GPU driver and CUDA troubleshooting
 



 • Git workflow, CI, tests that catch regressions
 



 • Enough math to read a loss curve and know what to change: optimization, LR schedules, overfitting on small data
 



 • Reads papers and repos, reproduces results, keeps experiment logs (W\&B or equivalent)
 



  





 No degree required. Skills over credentials.
 



  





 WHAT HUNGER LOOKS LIKE TO US
 



 • You ship without being told. Your GitHub shows it.
 



 • You'd rather run the experiment than debate it.
 



 • You ask for more scope, not more instructions.
 



 • You say when something is broken, including our decisions.
 



  





 HOW TO APPLY
 



 Send email to careers@recollia.ai with one thing you built: repo, demo, or write\-up. In three sentences, tell us what it does, what broke, and what you'd do differently.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**👩 💻 The role** 




 We're looking for a sharp, hungry analyst to join the data team at Headout. This is a foundational role, you'll work closely with senior analysts and leadership to build the reports, dashboards, and automations that power decisions across the company.
 



  





 Depending on where the need is greatest and where your strengths lie, you could find yourself working on growth and marketing analytics, product analytics, operations and supply\-side problems, or a mix of all three. The common thread: you'll be embedded in the business, working on problems that matter.
 



  





 This isn't about crunching numbers in a corner. You'll understand how our marketplace works, why metrics move, and what levers actually drive outcomes. You'll ship real work within your first week, and own meaningful workstreams within your first few months.
 



  





 If you're someone who gets restless when you're not learning, who'd rather figure things out than wait for instructions, and who cares about craft, this is for you.
 



  





**🤩 What makes this role special?** 



* **Real problems, not busywork** 
 : Headout is a global marketplace operating across dozens of cities, thousands of experiences, multiple currencies, real\-time inventory, and dynamic pricing. Whether you're analyzing conversion funnels, attribution models, supplier economics, or product experiments, the problems here are genuinely hard.
* **Breadth of exposure** 
 : You won't be siloed into one corner of the business. You'll see how growth, product, operations, and finance interconnect and build the analytical muscle to work across all of them.
* **Learn fast by doing** 
 : You'll pair with senior analysts on complex projects, get direct feedback from leadership, and see your work influence actual decisions. The feedback loops are tight, and the growth curve is steep.
* **A team that gives a damn** 
 : We care about speed and pragmatism over perfection, but we don't ship sloppy work. Feedback is direct and frequent. We document what we learn. We help each other get better.
* **A product you can care about** 
 : Headout helps people experience the best of every city they visit. There's something satisfying about working on a product where the output is someone having a great day somewhere new.



  





**💝 What skills \& experience do you need?** 



* 1 \- 3 years in an analytics, BI, or data science role
* Strong SQL skills, you can write complex joins, window functions, CTEs without hand\-holding. You know how to debug a slow query.
* Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation, automation, or simple analysis
* Hands\-on experience with at least one BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
* Nice to have: exposure to dbt, Airflow, or similar; basic understanding of data warehousing concepts
* Bonus: exposure to marketplace/e\-commerce, consumer tech

title: Testing & Configuration Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity**
 Hitachi Energy is looking for a Communication Systems Engineer to strengthen its capabilities in substation automation and protection communication networks. This role offers the opportunity to work on mission‑critical communication systems that enable reliable protection, monitoring, and control of power networks. The position involves close interaction with product management, engineering, testing, sales, and customers, and requires continuous engagement with evolving product features and communication technologies. The role is well suited for candidates who are technically curious, hands‑on, and motivated to contribute across design, deployment, and operational support within the Grid Automation ecosystem.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Contribute to engineering support activities by proposing technical solutions, optimizing feature usage, and supporting the adoption of new communication technologies in substation environments.
* Support sales and tender engineering through technical validations, product selection, standards compliance checks, and development of technically sound solution concepts.
* Work with the testing organization to define project‑specific test strategies, prepare FAT documentation, and support validation of new functionalities and technologies.
* Provide commissioning and integration support at customer sites, ensuring compatibility with existing communication networks and adherence to customer requirements.
* Participate in type testing and certification activities relevant to the Indian market, including regulatory and customer‑specific test requirements.
* Handle after‑sales technical support and root cause analysis, identifying fault patterns and driving corrective and preventive actions to improve product performance.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by translating field experience and fault trends into functional enhancements and cost‑optimization proposals.
* Deliver technical trainings to internal teams and external stakeholders as required for new product introductions or technology upgrades.
* Prepare and present technical material for customers, seminars, pre‑tender discussions, and customer engagement forums.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Communication Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of basic electronics and communication engineering fundamentals.
* Exposure to or working knowledge of products such as ETL600, NSD570, FOX61x.
* Familiarity with communication technologies including SDH, PDH, Ethernet, and MPLS‑TP.
* Working knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, IEC 101, IEC 61850, and TCP/IP.
* Good understanding of how communication systems support protection schemes and automation functions within substations.
* Experience or exposure to engineering support, testing, commissioning, or technical after‑sales support in power or industrial communication systems.
* Ability to continuously learn and stay aligned with new technologies, standards, and product updates.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills for working across cross‑functional and customer‑facing teams.
* Proficiency in spoken and written English.

title: Software Development Engineer, Time & Pay Innovation
description:
**Description**
 Amazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid — accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE\-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real\-time platforms: a high\-throughput, event\-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code — you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics — real\-time and event\-driven — of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high\-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay\-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially.
   

  

 We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high\-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade\-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi\-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.


 Write high\-quality, well\-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews.
   

  

* Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade\-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade\-offs clearly.


 Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
   

  

* Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time.


 Contribute to system\-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews — propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures.
   

  

 Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE\-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits.
   

  

* Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs.


 Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth — without being asked.
   

  

 Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on\-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system — incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction\-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid\-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services — tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross\-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre\-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time — globally, across all business lines and geographies.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience
* 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Site Quality Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
 Responsible for applicable systems related to plant customer issues such as corrective requests. Leads containment activities. Ensures products and processes meet initial and long\-term quality standards (Examples: IATF, customer specific requirements, Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Product Parts Approval Process (PPAP) documentation submittal etc.). Supports change management activities for current product and Value Package Introduction (VPI) by supporting verification of products and processes to ensure key measures are met and analyzing data for decision support. Supports and or leads less complex quality audits. Serves as a quality technical resource to other functional areas. Supports the prioritization of continuous improvement with cross functional key business partners by utilizing industry proven methodology (Example: Lean Manufacturing, 7 step problem solving, Intelligent Quality Tools and Methods (IQTM), etc.). Basic understanding and application to Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) core tools. May lead less complex and/or support Safe Launch initiatives through VPI.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Manufacturing Knowledge \- Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.
   

  

 Quality Influence \- Ability to recognize stakeholders, create a forum to professionally extract stakeholder perspectives, drive and engage in constructive conflict, and to influence outcomes in order to ensure Cummins makes a balanced decision inclusive of Quality priorities.
   

  

 Advanced Product Quality Planning \- Leads the technical quality planning and ensures customer satisfaction through structured and measurable processes as defined by industry standard.
   

  

 Measurement Science \- Analyzes measurement processes throughout the relevant traceability chain to identify and quantify sources of measurement uncertainty relevant to the appropriate applied measurement science, “Metrology” e.g. Chemical, Dimensional, Electrical, Mechanical, Optical and Radiation and Physical.
   

  

 Problem Solving \- Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
   

  

 Production Part Approval Process \- Coordinates the level of submission of Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) activities and information related to the introduction of new or changed products and processes; dispositions the product’s readiness for production in accordance with the Production Parts Approval Process (PPAP) and APQP provisions of Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) manuals and Cummins procedures in order to meet supplier and customer requirements.
   

  

 Project Management \- Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a “project”). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.
   

  

 Quality Process Management \- Proficient application of quality tools and methods (e.g. APQP, FMEA, PPAP, SPC, Capability studies, Process Audit, inspection, test, etc.) to ensure quality of products, processes and services.
   

  

 Quality Systems Management \- Utilizes the quality tools and processes to ensure the quality management system is understood, implemented, maintained, and demonstrates its ability to consistently and effectively provide products/services that meet requirements.
   

  

 Statistical Foundations \- Applies statistical tools and technique to influence decision making; leverages understanding of data collection methods, key statistics, graphical and analytical methods to describe process performance, gain insights and drive improvement action
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

 Quality 4\.0 \- Leverages cloud\-based systems and digitization to drive improved quality outcomes. Knowledge and application of Quality 4\.0 (Q4\.0\) and digitization of quality management. Examples of Q4\.0 are cloud native software applications, digital twin, simulation, adaptive intelligence and connected systems.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent degree in Engineering or a related technical or scientific subject or experience equivalent is preferred.
   

  

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Minimal to intermediate level of relevant work experience required.

* Ability to implement corrective and preventive actions to achieve BIS and RFT targets.

* Help analyse system trends, performance metrics, and operational data to identify improvements

* Partner with Security teams on vulnerability remediation and operational compliance activities
* Participate in rotational shift coverage and on\-call support for critical production systems

title: Databricks Platform Engineer
description:
We are seeking a hands\-on
 **Databricks Platform Engineer** 
 to provide offshore operational support, platform administration, automation, monitoring, and continuous improvement for an enterprise
 **Databricks Lakehouse platform on AWS** 
 .
   

  

 The engineer will work closely with the onshore Senior Data Platform Engineer while independently managing assigned platform engineering and operational responsibilities. The role focuses on platform reliability, automation, incident management, security, governance, cost optimization, and supporting Data Engineering and Data Science teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide day\-to\-day Databricks platform administration and production operational support.
* Monitor platform cost, usage, capacity, performance, and resource utilization.
* Identify and recommend opportunities for Databricks and AWS cost optimization.
* Implement approved platform architecture, engineering standards, security controls, and operational processes.
* Monitor platform health and respond to incidents, service requests, and operational alerts.
* Troubleshoot and restore platform services across Databricks, AWS, networking, security, compute, and workloads.
* Develop and maintain automation using Terraform, Databricks REST APIs, CLI, Python/Shell scripting, and other appropriate tools.
* Support platform deployments, configuration changes, environment promotion, and release activities.
* Administer Databricks workspaces, users, groups, permissions, compute, clusters, policies, and platform configurations.
* Manage Unity Catalog, including catalogs, schemas, external locations, storage credentials, grants, and access governance.
* Configure and manage compute policies and job policies.
* Support AWS\-integrated Databricks services and troubleshoot connectivity and security issues.
* Assist Data Engineering and Data Science teams with platform\-related issues, pipeline failures, compute problems, access issues, and workload troubleshooting.
* Perform initial investigation of complex platform issues and escalate to the appropriate engineering teams when required.
* Participate in proof\-of\-concept (POC) initiatives and evaluate emerging Databricks capabilities.
* Create and maintain runbooks, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and platform documentation.
* Provide effective shift handoffs and offshore/onshore operational coverage.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, automation, operational efficiency, and support processes.


**Required Qualifications** 
  

  

* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience administering and supporting Databricks in a production environment.
* Strong experience supporting enterprise\-scale Databricks environments on AWS.
* AWS certification and Databricks certification are required.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of:
+ Databricks Account and Workspace Administration
+ Unity Catalog and access governance
+ Compute and Job Policies
+ Databricks cost and usage optimization
+ Databricks security and platform administration
+ Databricks REST APIs and CLI
+ Terraform\-based infrastructure automation

* Strong AWS knowledge across:
+ AWS IAM
+ VPC, networking and security
+ KMS
+ DynamoDB
+ MSK
+ S3
+ AWS PrivateLink
+ CloudWatch

* Experience with Python/Shell scripting and automation.
* Good understanding of data pipelines, SQL, ETL processes, and production workload troubleshooting.
* Experience with monitoring, incident management, root\-cause investigation, and service restoration.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across platform, compute, networking, security, access, and workload layers.
* Good understanding of enterprise cloud security, governance, and operational best practices.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with onshore engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, and support teams.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Experience with Databricks on AWS at enterprise scale.
* Experience with Databricks Jobs, Workflows, Delta Lake, SQL Warehouses, and serverless capabilities.
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Experience with CI/CD and DevOps tools such as Git, GitHub/GitLab, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins.
* Experience with Databricks cluster troubleshooting and Spark workload performance.
* Knowledge of AWS PrivateLink and secure Databricks networking architectures.
* Experience with platform observability and monitoring solutions.
* Experience participating in Databricks platform upgrades, migrations, and environment provisioning.
* Exposure to emerging Databricks features and platform POCs.


 Mandatory Skills
   

  

**Databricks Administration \| Databricks Production Support \| AWS \| Unity Catalog \| Terraform \| AWS IAM \| VPC/Networking \| S3 \| KMS \| PrivateLink \| CloudWatch \| Databricks REST API/CLI \| Cost Optimization \| Python/Shell \| Monitoring \& Incident Management \| SQL/ETL**

In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1\) at NTT DATA, you'll step into an entry\-level role where your primary focus will be providing managed services to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. Your day will involve proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems to support our clients effectively.
   

  

 You'll monitor client infrastructure and solutions, catching errors before or as soon as they occur. Your role will involve investigating first\-line incidents, understanding their root causes, and following approved procedures for request fulfilment. Whether it's providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support, executing maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes, or ensuring smooth shift handovers for continuous service, your efforts are all about maintaining high standards of service quality.

Your role may occasionally extend to supporting project work and disaster recovery functions and tests, contributing to our broader goals and ensuring we're always ahead of the curve.
   

  

 Throughout your journey with us, you'll ensure that incidents and requests are resolved efficiently and comprehensively, escalating when necessary. You'll also help update existing knowledge or to share valuable insights, ensuring we continuously learn and improve.

* Basic understanding in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Virtual Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet Firewalls, Cisco Nexus switches, ASr and ISr routers, Cisco ACS, ISE, Meraki switches, and common routing protocols like BGP, OSPF, and EIGrP.
* Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day\-to\-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.

* Good understanding of using ITSM tools and ITSM processes.
* Strong planning skills, considering possible changes and circumstances.
* A strong work ethic, including the capacity to put in longer hours when necessary.
* Adaptability to changing environments.
* A client\-focused approach, creating positive client experiences throughout their journey.

Its ground\-breaking Next\-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi\-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.
   

  

***What We Need***
 NetBrain is looking for a Network Development Engineer with a focus on Platform Development to join our growing Platform team. In this role, you will apply deep Python expertise and networking knowledge to design and build scalable integration solutions that power Net Brain’s automation platform. You will work directly with enterprise customers to understand real\-world networking challenges and translate them into robust, production\-grade platform capabilities
   

  

 This role combines strong software engineering expertise with deep networking knowledge and direct customer collaboration. Unlike a traditional backend\-only development role, engineers in this position work closely with enterprise customers to understand real\-world networking challenges and design scalable platform and integration solutions.

* Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality Python services and APIs that power Net Brain’s automation platform.

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on integration design and delivery.

* Ability to handle edge cases, failure scenarios, and production concerns with rigor.

title: Embedded System Engineer
description:
**About ULOOK** 




 ULOOK is a deep\-tech company pioneering an Indigenous Autonomous RF\-Intelligence Stack from orbit. We develop autonomous satellite swarms and advance RF sensing technologies which transform faint electromagnetic emissions into real\-time intelligence. With our proprietary technology we identify, geolocate and fingerprint complex signals in environments where traditional sensors fail. We operate at the intersection of defense, space, and intelligence, providing global partners with unmatched situational awareness across all domains.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an Embedded Systems Engineer with 3–6 years of experience to support firmware development, board bring\-up, and system\-level integration of space\-grade embedded platforms. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with C/C\+\+, Python, Linux\-based environments, and diverse evaluation boards. Your contributions will be vital to realizing autonomous in\-orbit signal detection and processing capabilities.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Develop embedded firmware in C/C\+\+ for FPGAs (RF\-SoC)
* Bring up evaluation boards and custom hardware platforms with peripheral interfaces like SPI, I2C, UART, and PCIe
* Develop and configure custom Linux device trees, bootloaders, and kernel modules
* Design and write custom device drivers
* Implement Python\-based scripts for hardware automation, testing, and data logging
* Collaborate with hardware and RF teams for system integration, sensor interfacing, and performance validation
* Support unit testing, hardware\-in\-loop simulations, and driver development for mission\-critical applications
* Maintain documentation, version control, and compliance with design processes suitable for space systems



**Required Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or related technical fields
* 3\+ years of experience in kernel\-level embedded Linux development and custom board bring\-up
* Proven ability to write custom Linux device drivers from scratch (not just user\-space scripting)
* Proficiency in C/C\+\+; good Python scripting skills
* Experience working with Linux device trees, kernel configuration, and bootloader customization
* Strong understanding of hardware\-software interfacing, including handling hardware interrupts and DMA for high\-throughput sensor data
* Demonstrated ability to work with datasheets, schematics, and board support packages (BSPs)
* Familiarity with debugging tools like JTAG, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and serial consoles



**Preferred Skills and Experience** 




  




* Direct experience working with Xilinx RFSoC or similar FPGA\-based architectures.
* Prior experience integrating custom Software Defined Radios (SDRs) or high\-speed RF frontends.
* Exposure to embedded systems for aerospace, or defense\-grade applications.
* Familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and issue tracking systems.
* Comfortable with cross\-functional collaboration involving RF, signal processing, and systems teams.



  





**Why Join ULOOK** 



* Collaborate with a globally experienced core team from aerospace and defense domains.
* Opportunity to build next\-generation embedded systems for real\-time space intelligence.



 If you are excited to challenge yourself, send “Application for Embedded Systems Engineer” as the subject line.
