title: Product Manager
description:
Our Company
   

  

 Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to craft beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.
   

  

 We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to building exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!
   

  

****Our Opportunity****
**Adobe Express is building the next generation of AI\-powered creative experiences used by hundreds of millions of creators worldwide. Our Imaging team works where Computer Vision, Generative AI, the Adobe Firefly platform, and creative workflows meet. They help users transform ideas into polished content quickly.**
**We're looking for a Product Manager who is passionate about building intelligent creative experiences and bringing ground breaking AI capabilities to customers worldwide. You'll partner with world\-class Engineering, Design, Applied Research, Data Science, and Adobe Firefly teams to build how millions of creators interact with AI every day.**
****What You'll Do****
**As a Product Manager on the AI Imaging team, you will:**
* Own one or more strategic product areas within Adobe Express Imaging, driving customer and business outcomes from initial idea to final release.
* Drive product discovery through customer research, competitive analysis, product analytics, and experimentation.
* Define product strategy for your product area, create clear product requirements, prioritize roadmaps, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.
* Design and run experiments, define success metrics, and iterate rapidly using customer insights and data.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Applied Research, Adobe Firefly, and Imaging Platform teams to bring ground breaking AI capabilities into intuitive creative workflows.
* Collaborate with Growth teams to improve activation, engagement, retention, and monetization across the customer journey.
* Coordinate complex launches across multiple cross\-functional teams while balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and business impact.
* Continuously simplify creative workflows and find chances to define AI\-powered editing faster, more intuitive, and more delightful.


****What You'll Work On****
**Depending on business priorities, you'll contribute to initiatives such as:**
* AI\-powered photo enhancement
* Intelligent editing workflows
* Generative image editing
* AI\-assisted content creation
* Computer vision experiences
* Smart editing recommendations
* Personalized creative experiences
* High\-performance mobile imaging
* AI\-powered creative workflows across Adobe Express


****What You'll Bring****
**Required**
* 2\-6 years of Product Management experience building and shipping consumer or SaaS products.
* Strong product intuition with a deep customer\-first perspective.
* Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and cross\-functional collaborators.
* Strong analytical abilities with experience defining critical metrics, interpreting product analytics, and running experiments.
* Experience building AI\-powered customer experiences.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and collaborator management skills.
* Demonstrated experience owning products from concept through launch with measurable customer or business impact.


**Preferred**
* Familiarity with Generative AI, Computer Vision, LLMs, multimodal AI, or intelligent creative technologies.
* Experience partnering with Applied Research or Machine Learning teams to translate AI capabilities into customer\-facing products.
* Understanding of AI product evaluation, experimentation frameworks, model quality, inference latency, and product trade\-offs.
* Experience building products used by millions of customers.


****Why Adobe****
**Adobe is redefining digital creativity through AI\-powered experiences that empower creators of every skill level. Join a team solving challenging product problems at global scale while working alongside world\-class engineers, designers, researchers, and AI experts to invent the future of creativity.**
**About Adobe**
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
   

  

 Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
   

  

**Let’s Adobe together**
 At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
   

  

 Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
   

  

 Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.
   

  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**
 Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
   

  

 At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

title: State Project Coordinator
description:
**Job Description**
**Tiered Approach**
 In Line With The Commitment To Safeguard Capacity And Support Personnel Already In The Organization, a Majority Of UNDP UNCDF/UNV Vacancies Are Advertised Using a Tiered Application Process Whereby
   

  

* Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates


 Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.
   

  

* Organizational Context:


 UNDP has been working in India since 1951 in almost all areas of human development. Together with the Government of India and development partners, we have worked towards eradicating poverty, reducing inequalities, strengthening local governance, enhancing community resilience, protecting the environment, supporting policy initiatives and institutional reforms, and accelerating sustainable development for all.
   

  

 With projects and programmes in every state and union territory in India, UNDP works with national and subnational government, and diverse development actors to deliver people\-centric results, particularly for the most vulnerable and marginalized communities. As the integrator for collective action on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) within the UN system, we are committed to supporting the Government of India’s national development vision and priorities and accelerating the achievement of the SDGs for the people and the planet.
   

  

 UNDP India’s New Country Programme (2023\-2027\) Builds On Our Prior Work And Aims To Provide An Integrated Approach To Development Solutions In Three Strategic Portfolios
   

  

* Strong, accountable and evidence\-led institutions for accelerated achievement of the SDGs.
* Enhanced economic opportunities and social protection to reduce inequality, with a focus on the marginalized.
* Climate\-smart solutions, sustainable ecosystems and resilient development for reduced vulnerability.


 South\-South cooperation, gender equality and social inclusion are promoted across the pillars. The programme is supported by a framework of renewed partnerships and blended finance solutions, strategic innovation and accelerator labs, and data and digital architecture.
   

  

 You are invited to join a team of future\-smart development professionals to support India in achieving the national and globally agreed goals. As part of the UNDP team, your focus will be to work with diverse stakeholders to find country\-specific solutions that lead to sustainable development and reach those furthest behind first.
   

  

* Office/Unit/Project Description


 The Action for Climate and Environment (ACE) Unit at UNDP is organized around the thematic areas of climate change adaptation and mitigation, natural resource management, biodiversity conservation, ecosystem \& land restoration, disaster management and resilience, and access to clean and efficient energy.
   

  

 The Natural Resource Management and Biodiversity pillar of ACE is supporting the Government of India in meeting national development objectives along with commitments under important multilateral environment agreements especially the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD). The programme/projects under the pillar have been supporting the Ministry of Environment, Forest \& Climate Change (MoEFCC), National and State level planning for land restoration and biodiversity conservation, habitat restoration, carbon sequestration through enhanced restoration, promotion of nature\-based livelihoods and One Health approach.
   

  

 UNDP is supporting the Ministry in the implementation of a GEF \-7 project “Sustainable management and restoration of degraded landscapes for achieving Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) in India”. The project aims to achieve land degradation neutrality by creating additional carbon sinks through an ecosystem\-based approach for restoring degraded agricultural, forest, pastoral lands, and surface water bodies. It involves enabling institutional frameworks and policies for integrated sustainable land management practices and up\-scaling landscape\-wide practices in 3 states Gujarat, Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh contributing to the national target of restoring 26 Mha of degraded lands by 2030\.
   

  

 The project being implemented over a period of five years will lead to the following outcomes: (1\) Enhanced national, state and district\-level enabling frameworks incentivizing SLM practices and supporting participatory multi\-sector platforms to avoid, reduce and reverse land degradation, biodiversity loss and climate mitigation; (2\) Integrated participatory landscape design and financing models established in support of avoidance, reduction and reversal of land degradation, desertification, biodiversity loss and negative impacts of climate change to generates multiple sustained environmental and economic benefits; (3\) Improved capacity for LDN monitoring, assessment and reporting to UNCCD in support of LDN target setting and evaluation of capacities of partners; allowing government institutions and other agencies to better document, analyse and disseminate effective intervention strategies for restoring productive landscapes and replication of best practices at national and state level, and at international level through improved South\-South cooperation, knowledge and adaptive management.
   

  

 UNDP seeks to engage a State Project Coordinator who will support the National Project Manager (NPM) in the implementation of the GEF\-GoI\-UNDP LDN project. S/he will also work closely with the NPMU, SPMU, LPMU and UNDP in the implementation of the project in the state. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic, motivated, and committed to making a positive contribution to development in India.
   

  

* Job Purpose and Scope of Work


**Main Purpose**
 The State Project Coordinator will work under the supervision and guidance of the National Project Manager (NPM), NPMU and State Project Management Unit (SPMU). S/he will work closely with National Project Management Unit (NPMU) and Landscape Project Management Unite (LPMU) in the implementation of the project in the project state. S/he will have the following responsibilities:
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Project Planning, Management and Implementation including support on Monitoring and Evaluation
* Support / Assist in planning, coordination, implementation and monitoring of the project to ensure that its results are in accordance with the project document and project results framework in the state.
* Assume full responsibility of project management on a daily basis in the state – budgeting, ensure adequate information flow, discussion and feedback among relevant stakeholders of the project.
* Develop state specific annual work plans and ensure accurate and timely reporting to MoEFCC and UNDP for activities of the project in the state.
* Guide the team at the landscape level and monitor the work undertaken by consultants employed under the project.
* Assist the NPMU/SPMU/UNDP in independent Mid\-term and Terminal Evaluation of the project.
* Stakeholder Coordination, Partnerships and Convergence and Resource Movilization
* Ensure regular communication and coordination with the National Project Management Unit, State Project Steering Committee, Landscape Level Committee and Management Unit, UNDP and MoEFCC with respect to project activities in the state.
* Foster partnerships with relevant line departments and technical institutions working on land and forest management and sustainable livelihood to bring convergence in the project.
* Organize, facilitate and participate in the periodic review meetings including State Project Steering Committee and State Technical Committee meetings at least once or twice, per year, subject to availability of members and follow up on decisions taken at such meetings.
* Coordinate with other state departments to ensure convergence and sharing knowledge and best practices learnt in the project landscapes for scale up and replication.
* Coordinate with NPMU and LPMU under the project to share lessons and experiences.
* Develop proposals for resource mobilization to augment support to the programme/project.
* Procurement, Contract and Operational Management
* Develop Terms of Reference for hiring / engagements of consultants/ institutions/consultancy firms to be hired to undertake project activities and help the state government/UNDP in contracting processes.
* Commission activities including research studies, state level assessments, conduct and impart training / workshops etc. and manage the operational aspects of procurement, event management, logistics etc. in coordination with the state nodal officer and UNDP.
* Manage and track contracts with project partners and flag any potential risks and suggest its mitigation measures. Ensure timely contract management and payments.
* Review quality and consistency of reports and deliverables by partner institutions/ responsible parties including financial reports from all project partners.
* Financial Management and Reporting
* Track and manage project expenditure in the state in accordance with the budget, financial rules and procedures of the State, MoEFCC and UNDP to ensure transparency, responsibility and timely achievement of project targets.
* Develop and ensure timely submission of Quarterly Progress Reports, Annual Progress Reports, Project Implementation Report and mid\-term progress reports to NPMU and UNDP, based on inputs from the landscape and state.
* Knowledge Management, Learning and Documentation
* Help in identification and documentation of best practices across thematic areas relevant to the project.
* Coordinate with NPMU and LPMU under the project to share lessons and experiences.


**The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.**
* Institutional Arrangement


**Reporting To:** 
 National Project Manager (NPM), NPSA 10
   

  

**Repotees to this position (if applicable):** 
 Landscape Project Officer (3 positions)\- UNV, Community Mobilizer\- UNV.
   

  

* Competencies:


**Core**
**Achieve Results:** 
 LEVEL 2: Scale up solutions and simplify processes, balance speed and accuracy in doing work
   

  

**Think Innovatively:** 
 LEVEL 2: Offer new ideas/ is open to new approaches, demonstrate systemic/integrated thinking
   

  

**Learn Continuously:** 
 LEVEL 2: Go outside comfort zone, learn from others, and support their learning
   

  

**Adapt with Agility:** 
 LEVEL 2: Adapt processes/approaches to new situations, involve others in change process
   

  

**Act with Determination:** 
 LEVEL 2: Able to persevere and deal with multiple sources of pressure simultaneously
   

  

**Engage and Partner:** 
 LEVEL 2: Is facilitator/integrator, bring people together, build/maintain coalitions/ partnerships
   

  

**Enable Diversity and Inclusion:** 
 LEVEL 2: Facilitate conversations to bridge differences, considers in decision making
   

  

**People Management Competencies**
 UNDP People Management Competencies can be found in the dedicated site. ( PeopleManagementCompetencies.pdf )
   

  

**Cross\-Functional \& Technical Competencies**
 Thematic Area: Business Direction and Strategy
   

  

 Name: Strategic Thinking
   

  

 Definition: Develop effective strategies and prioritised plans in line with UNDP’s mission and objectives, based on the systemic analysis of challenges, opportunities and potential risks; link the general vision to reality on the ground to create tangible targeted solutions; learn from a variety of sources to anticipate and effectively respond to both current and future trends; demonstrate foresight.
   

  

 Thematic Area: Business Management
   

  

 Name: Project Management
   

  

 Definition: Ability to plan, organize, prioritize and control resources, procedures and protocols to achieve specific goals
   

  

 Thematic Area: Business Management
   

  

 Name: Risk Management
   

  

 Definition: Identify and organize action around reducing, mitigating and proactively managing risks.
   

  

 Thematic Area: 2030 Agenda: Planet
   

  

 Name: Nature
   

  

 Definition: Ecosystems and Biodiversity: Natural Resource Management
   

  

* Minimum Qualifications of the Successful NPSA


**Min. Education Requirements**
* Secondary education is required.
* A university degree (bachelor´s degree) in Environmental Science/Forestry/ Agriculture/ Sustainable Development/ Social Sciences/ Public Policy/ Management or equivalent field will be given due consideration, but it is not a requirement.
* Min. years of relevant work experience:
* Minimum of 7 years (with secondary education) or 4 years (with bachelor’s degree) of relevant experience in natural resource management, biodiversity conservation, social development, or any other related fields.
* Required skills:
* Demonstrated technical experience in sustainable land management and socio\-economic development, with experience coordinating with government agencies, stakeholders, and Project Management Units (PMUs).
* Experience in preparing technical reports, strategic plans, and progress updates for government and other key stakeholders.
* Desired skills in addition to the competencies covered in the Competencies section:
* Demonstrated experience in leading technical teams and facilitating consultations with government stakeholders to support project implementation, monitoring and evaluation, coordination, and achievement of project objectives and targets.
* Hands\-on technical experience in the implementation and monitoring of development, environmental, or natural resource management projects.
* Experience working with Central and/or State Government departments, UN agencies, international organizations, or similar institutions, including coordination with government,
* Required Language(s):
* Fluency in English and Hindi or Gujrati is required.


**Equal opportunity**
 As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.
   

  

 UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.
   

  

**Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority**
 UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.
   

  

**Right to select multiple candidates**
 UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.
   

  

**Use of AI by candidates**
 Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection
   

  

**Scam alert**
 UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam\-alert.
   

  

**Data Privacy**
 Please click here to view UNDP Data Privacy Statement

description:

 MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
   

  

**Build Your Future with Fictiv – Connect with Us Today!**
 At Fictiv, we’re not just shaping the future of manufacturing—we’re building the operating system for sourcing custom mechanical parts. Our Fortune 500 customers trust us to deliver complex, high\-quality parts for cutting\-edge products, from autonomous electric vehicles to surgical systems and industrial robots.
   

  

 As we expand our operations in

 , we’re looking to connect with talented professionals who are passionate about manufacturing, engineering, and project management. While we don’t have an open position at the moment, we’re actively growing our network to build relationships with top talent for future opportunities.

 As an

 , you’ll play a key role in managing high\-mix, low\-volume projects, ensuring seamless execution from customer requirements to final delivery. By bridging the gap between our U.S.\-based customers and manufacturing partners, you’ll ensure production runs smoothly, meets specifications, and stays on budget—while continuously driving process improvements.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
 We’re seeking experienced engineers and project managers with:

 and other manufacturing processes like

 **data\-driven approach** 
 to problem\-solving and process improvement
   

  

 ✅
 **Fluency in English** 
 and experience in multicultural work environments

 **self\-starter mindset** 
 with the ability to thrive in dynamic, fast\-paced settings
   

  

 📍
 **This position will be required to work from our office in Bengaluru, India.**
**Why Join Fictiv’s Talent Network?**
 ✔ Stay ahead of future opportunities—be the first to hear when positions open
   

  

 ✔ Engage with our team—learn more about our
 **mission, culture, and impact**

 **manufacturing \& engineering**
 🚀
 **Ready to take the next step?** 
 Let’s start the conversation!
 **Submit your resume** 
 and we’ll keep you informed about exciting opportunities at
 **Fictiv India** 
 .
   

  

**Join us in building the future of manufacturing!** 
 🌎🔧✨
   

  

 We’re actively seeking teammates who:
   

  

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates


 We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

title: Communication Designer
description:
**About Fam (previously FamPay)**



  


  

  

  


  


  


  

  


  


  


 Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above 11\. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million\+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.
   

  

 We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.

From crafting visuals that stop the scroll to building systems that keep everything on\-point, you’ll obsess over the little details while shaping the bigger picture. You’ll work hands\-on with designers, marketers, and product teams to make sure every pixel feels intentional and every story feels bold.

* Maintain a set of design best practices and guidelines to streamline production efforts
  
* Research the latest design trends to create compelling visuals for the brand
  
* Solve marketing and business problems through creative design solutions
  
* Collaborate with marketing, product, and content teams to ensure cohesive visual storytelling
  

  



  




**Must\-haves (Min. qualifications)** 
  
* 1–4 years of full\-time experience as a visual and in product teams
  
* Hands\-on experience in visual communication design across app, social, web \& offline platforms
  
* Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro)
  
* Strong understanding of brand identity and maintaining brand consistency
  
* A portfolio showcasing strong design aesthetics and creative storytelling
  
* Comfortable using AI tools to optimise performance and deliver impactful designs
  
* Availability for a full\-time role and willingness to work from our Bangalore office
  

  



  




**Good to have** 
  
* Experience working with small teams and leading impactful projects
  
* You love doing IC work, and at the same time, collaborate well with other designers
  
* Ability to conduct and synthesize qualitative and quantitative research
  
* Ability to create illustrations that enhance brand storytelling
  
* A proactive, self\-driven approach with a hunger for learning and experimentation
  

  



  




**Why join us?** 
  
* Be part of a high\-energy, creatively driven team shaping the face of a growing brand
  
* High\-impact role where your design decisions will directly shape the experience for 10M\+ users
  
* Get creative freedom and room to experiment
  
* Collaborate with a team that values bold ideas and good vibes
  
* Access to the latest tools, resources, and inspiration to grow your craft
  

  






  




  


  

  


  
 


  

  




  



**Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck** 




  


 • Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.
 


  


 • Free office meals (lunch \& dinner).
 


  


 • Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.
 


  


 • Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.
 


  


 • Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.
 


  


 • Access the latest gadgets and tools.
 


  


 • Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.
 


  


 • Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.
 


  


 • Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.
 


  


  
 


  


**Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️**



  


 FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI \& card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.
 


  


  
 


  


**Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech** 



  


 FamApp has enabled 10 million\+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.
 


  


  
 


  


**Trusted by leading investors** 



  


 We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y\-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.
 


  


  
 


  


**Join Our Dynamic Team** 



  


 At Fam, our people\-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.
 


  


  
 


  


 Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛
   

  

**PS \- We’re looking for someone with an AI\-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day\-to\-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.** 
  




  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.  Excellent writing, grammar, and proofreading skills in both Malayalam and English

**experience**

title: Customer Success - Management Trainee
description:
**About Joveo** 




 As the global leader in AI\-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.
 



 The Joveo platform enables businesses to attract, source, engage, and hire the most relevant candidates on time, within their budget. Powering millions of jobs every day, our data\-driven recruitment marketing platform uses advanced data science and machine learning to dynamically manage and optimize talent sourcing and applications across all online channels while providing real\-time insights at every step of the job seeker journey, from click to hire.
 



 For more information, visit
 
 www.joveo.com
 




  





**🌟 About the Role:
 
 Management Trainee (Path to Customer Success Manager)**




 The
 **Customer Success Manager** 
 at Joveo isn’t a support function—it’s a high\-stakes, advisory role for a storyteller, a strategist, and a growth architect.
 



 You won’t just "manage" clients; you will be their most trusted advisor in the recruitment tech space. You’ll sit at the intersection of data and human capital, transforming complex programmatic advertising metrics into multi\-million dollar ROI narratives. This role is about driving
 **Value Realization** 
 —ensuring our clients don’t just use Joveo, but win with Joveo.
 



  





**🧠 What You’ll Do** 



* **Be the ROI Storyteller:** 
 Move beyond reporting metrics. Transform raw data into compelling narratives that prove Joveo’s impact on a client’s bottom line.
* **Command the Boardroom:** 
 Own the relationship with Director and CXO\-level stakeholders. You won’t just "do" QBRs; you’ll lead strategic sessions that shape the client’s long\-term talent strategy.
* **Architect Success Playbooks:** 
 Don’t just follow a process. Design and execute project blueprints that ensure seamless adoption of Joveo’s cutting\-edge AI and programmatic solutions.
* **Internal Product Catalyst:** 
 Be the voice of the customer. Use your frontline insights to influence our product roadmap, ensuring Joveo stays years ahead of industry needs.
* **Drive the "Health" Agenda:** 
 Monitor account vitals with surgical precision. Identify risks before they surface and turn challenges into opportunities for expansion and advocacy.
* **Mobilize the Powerhouse:** 
 Act as the "CEO of your book of business," rallying cross\-functional teams (Product, Data Science, Sales) to deliver on bold promises.



  





**🎯 What We’re Looking For** 



* **0\-3 years of experience** 
 in Customer Success or Strategic Account Management (Bonus points if you’ve navigated the HR Tech, SaaS, or Recruitment Marketing landscape).
* **The "Consultant" Vibe:** 
 You don't just answer questions; you provide world\-class advisory that challenges clients to think bigger.
* **Analytical Rigor:** 
 You are a wizard with data. Pivot tables and charts are your tools for unearthing clarity from chaos.
* **Executive Presence:** 
 You speak the language of CXOs—confident, concise, and outcome\-oriented.
* **An Owner’s Heart:** 
 You are self\-starting and thrive in high\-autonomy environments. You see a gap and you fill it.
* **The Advocacy Spark:** 
 You have a track record of turning quiet users into vocal brand champions and case\-study stars.



  





**💡 Why Joveo** 



* **Own the Narrative:** 
 You’re not a cog in a machine; you are the primary driver of client retention and happiness in a global growth\-stage company.
* **Shape the Industry:** 
 Be at the forefront of the AI revolution in recruitment marketing, helping the world’s biggest brands find the right talent faster.
* **High\-Velocity Culture:** 
 Work in an environment where speed is a feature, and ownership is the baseline.
* **Growth Potential:** 
 At Joveo, Customer Success is the engine of our growth. Proving your impact here opens doors to leadership and strategic roles across the organization.



  





**🔥 If you can turn data into destiny and clients into champions—this is your stage. Let’s redefine the future of recruitment marketing.**

title: Full Stack Engineer — AI Commerce Platform
description:
**Who We Are**
 At JD.com, also known as JINGDONG, we are building one of the world’s most trusted technology and supply chain ecosystems. What started as a bold idea in China has evolved into a NASDAQ\-listed, Fortune 44 global enterprise serving over 700 million active customers. Powered by advanced logistics, innovative technology, and a commitment to integrity, JD.com operates across retail, logistics, technology, property and more, creating solutions that make everyday life smarter, faster, and more connected.
   

  

**Our Global Reach**
 JD.com is expanding its international footprint through a digitally intelligent, cross\-border supply chain and world\-class logistics network, supported by platforms such as Joybuy, which brings trusted products to customers worldwide. Today, our teams operate across China, the U.S., U.K., Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Hungary, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and beyond, reaching customers in every corner of the world.
   

  

 Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://corporate.jd.com/
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Joining JD.com means becoming part of a company where people, innovation, and impact go hand in hand. We offer a competitive salary, a great location, and a supportive, people\-first culture where your growth truly matters. With access to global projects, learning opportunities, and an inclusive environment that values every voice, you’ll have the space to shape the future with us.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You’ll be joining the JD.com team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high\-quality results in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
   

  

**核心职责**
**AI模型智能路由决策系统** 
 ：设计并实现多策略AI模型路由引擎，实现请求到模型的最优匹配，保证低延迟决策，并确保路由决策透明可审计
 **AI算力商品化与计费系统** 
 ：构建多层级算力定价与计费引擎，实现精细化成本核算与防套利机制
 **基础设施与可靠性** 
 ：微服务架构部署与优化、缓存与熔断机制设计、数据库事务保障、高可用架构与故障自动切换
 **AI模型能力评测与价格数据管道** 
 ：主流AI模型能力评测数据整合 \+ 平台用户反馈聚合 \+ 实时价格缓存与同步
 **性能工程** 
 ：冷启动优化 \+ 压测验证 \+ 在线学习与实时统计
   

  

 硬性要求
   

  

* 3年\+全栈开发经验，具备以下三个认知维度中的至少两个：
+ AI模型认知：深入理解主流LLM模型的能力边界、成本结构、API协议（OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/国产模型），对模型选型和性价比评估有实战经验
+ AI模型聚合认知：理解多模型聚合架构（API Gateway/Proxy/Router模式），对模型路由、负载均衡、故障转移、成本优化有工程经验或深度认知
+ AI智能路由/Commerce认知：有智能决策系统（推荐/路由/调度/竞价/计费）开发经验，理解"算力商品化"——将AI推理能力从技术接口转化为可定价、可订阅、可审计的商业产品

* 精通Go或Python后端 \+ Next.js/React前端，能独立完成从API设计→前端实现→部署上线的全链路
* 有低延迟决策系统经验（推荐/路由/调度/竞价）
* 精通Redis \+ PostgreSQL，理解在线学习/实时统计等算法
* 有SaaS计费/订阅/支付系统集成相关经验
* 有云原生/容器化部署与运维经验


 加分项
   

  

* 有AI模型路由/模型调度/算力调度相关经验
* 有推荐系统/广告引擎/电商交易系统经验——路由决策和成本优化的transferable技能
* 有多模型API网关/LLM Proxy开发经验（开源或商业产品均可）
* 有Multi\-Armed Bandit/A/B测试框架设计经验
* 有电商/支付/计费系统经验
* 有SLA 99\.9%\+系统运维经验
* 开源项目贡献者（GitHub 500\+ stars项目）

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*

title: Software Engineer (Frontend)
description:
**The Role** 
  





 We are looking for a Frontend Engineer to help shape the face of Simbian's product. You will work closely with design, product, and backend engineers to build the interfaces through which security teams interact with our AI agents. The work is technically demanding and visually consequential: you will be building dashboards, real\-time alert workflows, and investigation UIs that security analysts rely on under pressure.
   





  




**What You Will Do**
* Own and evolve core product surfaces: dashboards, alert queues, investigation flows, and agent activity timelines
* Build responsive, accessible, high\-performance UIs using ReactJS, Tailwind CSS, and ShadCN component primitives
   

 Architect reusable component libraries and design systems that scale with the product
* Collaborate with backend engineers to define clean API contracts and integrate real\-time data (WebSocket's, polling, streaming)
   

 Lead frontend technical decisions, from state management patterns to performance optimization strategies
* Participate in design reviews and push back when something is not implementable cleanly



  

  

  

  




 Requirements
   

  


 What We Are Looking For
   




* 1 to 3 years of professional frontend engineering experience
* Deep expertise in TypeScript and JavaScript; you write type safe code by default
* Strong command of ReactJS, including hooks, context, and component design patterns
* Handson experience with Tailwind CSS and component libraries (ShadCN or similar)
* Solid understanding of HTML semantics and CSS layout (flexbox, grid, responsive design)
* Ability to translate complex workflows and data heavy UIs into clean, intuitive interfaces
* Experience working in fastmoving, product focused environments where you ship often and iterate quickly Strong communication skills and comfort working cross functionally



  





 Nice to Have
   




* Experience building security tooling, SOC platforms, or enterprise SaaS dashboards
* Familiarity with real\-time data rendering (WebSockets, server sent events)
* Exposure to data visualization libraries (Recharts, D3, or similar)
* Experience setting up or contributing to a design system from scratch
* Prior work at an early\-stage startup and excellent pedigree


 Benefits
   

  


 Why Simbian?
   




 You will work on a product that is actively used by security teams defending real organizations from real threats
   

 Small team, large surface area: your decisions shape the product, not just your ticket queue
   

 Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits
   

 We move fast, we trust engineers, and we debate things openly

title: Front-End Engineer II
description:
**Description**
 We are seeking a talented Front End Engineer II to join the Paragon team and help build the future of case management for Stores. Paragon is a mission\-critical case management system (CMS) that serves 200\+ business teams within Stores, enabling them to manage communications and interactions with millions of customers efficiently. As our customers rely on Paragon daily to deliver exceptional customer experiences, you'll play a vital role in building and evolving the platform that powers their success.
   

  

 In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain the user interfaces for Paragon's core components. You'll work extensively on Paragon Workbench, the main application that associates use every day to help customers—including sellers, vendors, and advertisers—and to investigate fraud cases. Workbench simplifies complex support work by organizing it into clear steps: understanding what the problem is, figuring out how to fix it, and communicating the solution. The interface provides agents with helpful tools at each step, making their work more efficient and effective. Some of these tools are built by our platform team, while others are customized by individual business teams to fit their unique needs.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, and cross\-functional teams to build scalable, high\-quality, responsive, performant, and accessible solutions that serve thousands of customers with varying needs. This position offers an opportunity to make significant technical contributions to a platform that directly impacts business operations across the organization while growing your skills in enterprise\-scale front\-end development.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain web applications using React and modern JavaScript
* Build reusable components and front\-end libraries
* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions
* Develop and maintain micro\-frontend and composable\-UI architectures, that enable infinite UI variation without technical debt
* Mentor engineers to grow systems thinking
* Partner with UX/UI designers, backend engineers, product managers, and business teams to translate requirements and designs into functional features, integrate with platform services and APIs, and deliver solutions that meet diverse customer needs
* Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability
* Implement responsive design and ensure cross\-browser compatibility
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code
* Conduct Code reviews that improve capability, not just code
* Troubleshoot and debug issues in production environments


**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of non\-internship professional front end, web or mobile software development using JavaScript, HTML and CSS experience
* 4\+ years of computer science fundamentals (object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis) experience
* Experience using JavaScript frameworks such as angular and react


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of agile software development methodology experience

title: Software Development Engineer, Time & Pay Innovation
description:
**Description**
 Amazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid — accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE\-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real\-time platforms: a high\-throughput, event\-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code — you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics — real\-time and event\-driven — of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high\-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay\-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially.
   

  

 We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high\-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade\-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi\-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.


 Write high\-quality, well\-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews.
   

  

* Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade\-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade\-offs clearly.


 Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
   

  

* Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time.


 Contribute to system\-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews — propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures.
   

  

 Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE\-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits.
   

  

* Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs.


 Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth — without being asked.
   

  

 Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on\-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system — incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction\-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid\-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services — tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross\-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre\-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time — globally, across all business lines and geographies.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience
* 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
Facility Manager

Company: Phoenix Business Advisory

Department: Administration \& Operations

Location: Ahmedabad

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Experience: 3–6 Years

Reports To: HR Manager

About Phoenix Business Advisory

Phoenix Business Advisory is a business advisory firm specializing in business immigration and related advisory services. We are committed to maintaining a professional, efficient, and well\-managed workplace that supports our employees and business operations.

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and experienced Facility Manager to oversee the day\-to\-day management, maintenance, safety, and smooth functioning of our office facilities.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining a safe, clean, comfortable, and well\-organized workplace while managing vendors, office infrastructure, housekeeping, supplies, maintenance activities, facility expenses, and administrative requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Facility \& Office Management

\- Manage the day\-to\-day operations and upkeep of the office premises.

\- Ensure the workplace is clean, organized, safe, and well\-maintained.

\- Monitor office infrastructure, furniture, fixtures, electrical systems, HVAC/AC, plumbing, and other facilities.

\- Conduct regular facility inspections and ensure timely resolution of issues.

\- Proactively identify and address potential facility\-related concerns.

Vendor \& Service Provider Management

\- Coordinate with housekeeping, security, maintenance, pest control, electrical, plumbing, and other service providers.

\- Manage vendor relationships and ensure services meet required standards.

\- Obtain quotations and coordinate approvals for facility\-related purchases and services.

\- Track vendor bills, contracts, renewals, and service schedules.

\- Escalate and resolve vendor\-related issues in a timely manner.

Office Administration

\- Manage office supplies, stationery, pantry requirements, and administrative consumables.

\- Monitor inventory and coordinate timely procurement.

\- Maintain records of office assets, equipment, and facility materials.

\- Coordinate seating arrangements and workspace requirements.

\- Support office events, meetings, employee activities, and other administrative requirements.

Safety \& Security

\- Ensure workplace safety and security standards are maintained.

\- Coordinate with security personnel and manage office access and visitor requirements.

\- Ensure fire safety equipment and emergency systems are regularly inspected and maintained.

\- Handle emergency repairs and safety\-related concerns promptly.

\- Maintain relevant safety and facility documentation.

Maintenance \& Infrastructure

\- Plan and coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance.

\- Coordinate servicing and repairs related to electrical, HVAC/AC, plumbing, internet/network infrastructure, and office equipment.

\- Maintain records of maintenance activities and service schedules.

\- Minimize operational disruptions through proactive maintenance.

Budget \& Cost Management

\- Monitor facility and administrative expenses.

\- Maintain records of vendor payments and facility\-related expenditures.

\- Support budgeting and cost\-control initiatives.

\- Identify opportunities to optimize facility costs without compromising service quality.

Employee Support

\- Address employee concerns related to workplace facilities and infrastructure.

\- Ensure employees have a comfortable and functional working environment.

\- Coordinate with HR and Operations on facility\-related requirements.

\- Respond promptly to facility requests and ensure proper closure.

Compliance \& Documentation

\- Maintain records related to vendors, contracts, assets, maintenance, and facility operations.

\- Track required licenses, certificates, inspections, and renewals.

\- Support management and HR during audits and facility\-related compliance requirements.

Required Qualifications \& Skills

\- Bachelor's degree in Facility Management, Business Administration, Operations, or a related field.

\- 3–6 years of experience in facility management, office administration, workplace operations, or a similar role.

\- Strong vendor management and negotiation skills.

\- Good understanding of office infrastructure and maintenance.

\- Strong organizational, coordination, and multitasking abilities.

\- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

\- Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.

\- Ability to handle emergencies and operational issues effectively.

\- Proficiency in MS Office and Google Workspace.

\- Ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams and external service providers.

Preferred Skills

\- Experience managing corporate offices.

\- Experience handling multiple vendors and service providers.

\- Knowledge of workplace health, safety, and security practices.

\- Basic understanding of electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and general building maintenance.

\- Ability to work independently and take ownership of facility operations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\- Timely resolution of facility and maintenance issues.

\- Office cleanliness and workplace standards.

\- Vendor performance and service quality.

\- Effective facility cost management.

\- Timely completion of preventive maintenance.

\- Availability of office supplies and functional infrastructure.

\- Employee satisfaction with workplace facilities.

\- Timely completion of safety and compliance requirements.

What We Offer

\- Professional and growth\-oriented work environment.

\- Opportunity to work closely with management and cross\-functional teams.

\- Exposure to workplace administration and business operations.

\- Professional growth and development opportunities.

* Monitor and optimize CPL, CPA, CTR, Conversion Rate, ROAS, and Lead Quality. Conduct continuous A/B testing across creatives, ad copies, audiences, landing pages, and campaign strategies.

title: Branch Manager
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Branch Operations

* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the clinic and ensure smooth functioning of all departments.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs, operational policies, and quality standards.
* Monitor clinic infrastructure, hygiene, housekeeping, equipment, and overall branch readiness.
* Ensure timely resolution of operational issues and escalate critical matters to the management.
* Maintain proper coordination between Front Desk, Sales, Clinical, Administration, and Support teams.

2\. Revenue \& Business Growth

* Take ownership of the branch's revenue and business performance.
* Drive achievement of monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
* Monitor consultations, conversions, treatment bookings, revenue per patient, and other key business metrics.
* Identify opportunities to increase patient acquisition, repeat visits, referrals, and treatment conversions.
* Develop and implement local business\-development initiatives in coordination with the central marketing team.
* Monitor competitor activity and local market trends to identify potential growth opportunities.

3\. Patient Experience \& Consultation Management

* Ensure a professional, welcoming, and premium patient experience throughout the patient's journey.
* Monitor patient feedback, complaints, and service issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Coordinate with doctors and consultants to ensure smooth patient flow and effective consultation management.
* Ensure proper follow\-up of leads, consultations, procedures, and treatment plans.
* Maintain high standards of patient communication and service quality.

4\. Team Management

* Lead, motivate, and manage the branch team to achieve operational and business objectives.
* Set clear targets and performance expectations for team members.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
* Identify training and development requirements for employees.
* Manage attendance, discipline, productivity, and overall employee engagement at the branch.
* Support recruitment and onboarding of branch\-level employees in coordination with HR.
* Build a positive, accountable, and performance\-oriented team culture.

5\. Sales \& Lead Management

* Monitor the complete lead\-to\-conversion funnel.
* Ensure timely follow\-up on enquiries, leads, consultations, and pending treatment cases.
* Track sales performance and identify reasons for missed conversions.
* Coach the sales/front\-office team on patient communication, follow\-up, and conversion practices.
* Ensure accurate reporting of sales and revenue data.

6\. MIS \& Reporting

* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly branch performance reports.
* Track key metrics including:
* Leads \& Enquiries
* Consultations
* Conversion Rate
* Treatment Bookings
* Revenue
* Follow\-ups
* Patient Feedback
* Team Productivity
* Share branch performance updates with the reporting manager and management team.
* Maintain accurate operational and business records.

7\. Compliance \& Quality

* Ensure compliance with company policies, clinical protocols, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality and security of patient information.
* Ensure proper documentation and record\-keeping at the branch.
* Coordinate with internal teams during audits, inspections, and quality reviews.
* Promote a culture of ethical patient communication and professional conduct.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly Branch Revenue
* Revenue Target Achievement %
* Consultation\-to\-Treatment Conversion %
* Lead\-to\-Consultation Conversion %
* Patient Retention \& Repeat Business
* Patient Satisfaction
* Team Productivity
* Lead Follow\-up Efficiency
* Operational Compliance
* Employee Attendance \& Retention
* Branch Profitability / Cost Efficiency

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Hospitality, Sales, or a related field.
* MBA / PGDM in Sales, Marketing, Healthcare Management, or Business Administration will be an advantage.
* **3–7 years of relevant experience**, preferably in healthcare, dermatology, hair transplant, aesthetic, wellness, hospitality, or premium service industries.
* Prior experience managing a branch, clinic, centre, showroom, or service business is preferred.

Required Skills

* Strong leadership and people\-management skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong sales and business\-development orientation
* Customer / patient relationship management
* Team handling and performance management
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Strong follow\-up and negotiation skills
* Data\-driven approach to branch performance
* Good knowledge of MS Office / Google Workspace and CRM systems
* Ability to work in a target\-driven environment

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are looking for an individual who is:

* **Result\-oriented and commercially driven**
* Confident in handling teams and customers
* Strong in sales conversion and relationship management
* Comfortable managing multiple responsibilities simultaneously
* Professional, well\-groomed, and service\-oriented
* Proactive in identifying and solving operational challenges
* Capable of working in a fast\-paced healthcare environment
* Focused on both **patient experience and business performance**

title: Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition & Operations
description:
**Company:** Elite Butlers Hospitality Solutions  

**Location:** RPS 12th Avenue, Faridabad, Delhi NCR  

**Work Mode:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  

**Experience:** 10\+ years preferred  

**Team:** India \& UAE \| Currently \~15 members, expanding further


### **About the Role**


Elite Butlers Hospitality Solutions is looking for an experienced and highly capable **Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition \& Operations** to lead and strengthen our recruitment delivery across India and the UAE.


The role will oversee a growing team of recruiters and support functions while personally leading **senior and critical mandates for HNI/UHNI families, private residences, family offices, luxury hospitality and corporate clients**.


We are looking for someone who combines **strong recruitment expertise, team leadership, client management and operational discipline**.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Lead and manage a **15\+ member recruitment/operations team** across India and UAE, with the ability to scale the function to 20–30\+ members.
* Allocate and prioritise mandates based on urgency, business value and recruiter capability.
* Conduct **first/second\-level interviews** and quality checks before senior candidates are presented to clients.
* Personally manage critical and senior\-level mandates.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality profiles and improve closure ratios.
* Conduct daily/weekly reviews covering mandates, pipelines, interviews, offers, joining and revenue.
* Coach recruiters on sourcing, interviewing, candidate presentation, negotiation and client handling.
* Coordinate closely with the **CRM/client servicing team** from requirement initiation through closure.
* Join client calls/meetings where senior intervention is required.
* Understand client requirements and convert them into clear recruitment strategies.
* Monitor proposals, commercials, engagement terms, invoices and payment follow\-ups in coordination with the relevant teams.
* Manage candidate negotiations, counter\-offers, notice periods and joining challenges.
* Ensure proper use of **ATS/CRM/HRMS**, accurate data and recruitment reporting.
* Develop recruitment SOPs, productivity benchmarks and quality standards.
* Support hiring, induction and development of new recruiters as the team expands.
* Oversee recruitment delivery across multiple locations/offices as the company grows.

### **Candidate Profile**


We are ideally looking for someone with:


* **10\+ years of recruitment/Talent Acquisition experience**
* Previous experience managing approximately **10–20 recruiters/team members**
* Strong exposure to **hospitality, HNI/UHNI recruitment, private staffing, executive search or luxury services**
* Experience handling senior and confidential mandates
* Excellent interviewing and candidate\-assessment skills
* Strong client\-facing and commercial understanding
* Experience using ATS/CRM/HRMS platforms
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Strong Excel/reporting and digital skills
* Ability to work in a fast\-moving entrepreneurial environment

The person should be **smart, polished, well\-presented, commercially aware and comfortable interacting with senior candidates, HNI/UHNI clients and business leaders.**


### **What Success Looks Like**


The person should bring **structure, accountability and quality** to the entire TA operation, ensuring recruiters are productive, mandates move within defined timelines, clients receive strong profiles, senior positions receive personal attention, and the recruitment function scales without compromising service standards.


There is significant scope for this position to grow into **Manager / Senior Manager – Talent Acquisition \& Operations**, with responsibility for multiple teams and locations across India, UAE and other international markets.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a dedicated and proactive HR Executive to manage and support various HR functions, including recruitment, employee onboarding, payroll processing, and employee engagement. The ideal candidate will have at least 2\-3 years of experience in the real estate or hospitality industry and will play a key role in ensuring smooth HR operations while contributing to maintaining a positive work environment.

Key Responsibilities:

1\. Recruitment and Staffing:

\- Maintain and update the organization chart, identifying various vacancies.

\- Work closely with Directors and HODs to take approval for recruitment and plan accordingly.

\- Prepare detailed Job Descriptions (JDs) and salary budgets with the assistance of HODs and Directors.

\- Source CVs through advertisements, job portals, internal references, and other sources.

\- Conduct preliminary rounds of interviews and capture candidate details (current and expected salary, notice period).

\- Coordinate with HODs and Directors for scheduling interviews.

\- Download and maintain records of CVs, shortlisted candidates, rejected candidates, and hold CVs.

\- Prepare salary break\-up sheets and obtain Director's approval.

\- Send offer letters to selected candidates and confirm joining dates.

\- Maintain a record of offers issued and follow up on their acceptance.

2\. Onboarding and Employee Documentation:

\- Inform IT department of any laptop/desktop requirements for new joiners on their joining day.

\- Prepare and maintain monthly MIS on the number of candidates attending interviews, vacancy status, etc.

\- Advertise vacancies on LinkedIn, Naukri.com, and other platforms to increase employer brand awareness.

\- Review and capture job descriptions from other builders’ websites and job portals to update internal records.

\- Greet new employees, provide a welcome message via WhatsApp group, and guide them through the onboarding process.

\- Prepare and verify new joiner documents, ensuring proper documentation and filing.

\- Issue appointment letters within one week of joining.

\- Perform a thorough review and scanning of new joiner documents and ensure all paperwork is completed.

\- Allot employee numbers in the master sheet and update biometric records on the first day.

\- Prepare and distribute detailed job descriptions to new employees within one week of joining.

\- Conduct HR inductions, introducing new employees to company policies, procedures, and SOPs.

\- Introduce new employees to the office staff, HODs, and Directors.

\- Coordinate with the front desk executive to manage leaves, attendance, and other HR\-related tasks.

3\. Payroll and Benefits Administration:

\- Coordinate with Axis Bank for the opening of new bank accounts for employees.

\- Update bank account details in the employee master sheet.

\- Plan and execute payroll policies, salary structure (breakups), and payment methods.

\- Gather, validate, and calculate employee inputs for payroll processing in coordination with the Accounts Department.

\- Prepare the monthly payroll sheet by the 25th of each month, including updates for new employees, deletions, salary revisions, and bank details.

4\. Employee Relations and Retention:

\- Plan and execute employee retention programs, exit interviews, and full \& final settlements.

\- Issue experience and relieving certificates to employees leaving the organization.

\- Assist in staff seating arrangements and provide administrative support to the HR head.

\- Coordinate with staff and new joiners to address their needs and requirements.

5\. Administrative Support:

\- Supervise housekeeping and maintenance of the corporate office by conducting daily rounds.

\- Assist the front desk executive with inward/outward records, visitor management, stationery, petty cash, and pantry requirements.

\- Coordinate with the IT Department to address technical issues faced by staff.

\- Manage vendor relationships for advertisement services, PF, Naukri, etc.

\- Plan and execute staff birthdays, sports events, and other employee engagement activities on a weekly basis.

Skills and Qualifications:

\- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.

\- At least 2\-3 years of experience in HR roles, specifically within the real estate or hospitality industry.

\- Proven experience in recruitment, onboarding, payroll, and employee relations.

Industry Preference: Retail / Supermarket / QSR / Multi\-Location Business

\#About the Role

Vishram Management Group is shifting its global backend operations to its Ahmedabad office and is looking for a strong Multiunit Operations Manager to take complete ownership of the India backend operation.

This person will act as the single point of contact between U.S. leadership and the India team, ensuring that Accounting, HR, Marketing, and Technology functions operate efficiently, meet deadlines, and support the performance of our U.S. businesses.

We're looking for someone with a retail business management background who has managed operations beyond the store level — including accounting oversight, HR, marketing, reporting, systems, and team management.

\#Functions You Will Oversee

You will directly manage and hold accountable:

\- Marketing Center of Excellence

\- VMG Human Resources

\- Accounting Teams – Vishram Group

\- Technology / IT Manager

\- Backend Business Operations \& Reporting

\# Key Responsibilities

Business Operations

\- Take complete ownership of VMG's Ahmedabad backend operation

\- Act as the primary point of contact for U.S. management

\- Convert management priorities into clear tasks, deadlines, KPIs, and accountability

\- Conduct daily/weekly operational reviews with department managers

\- Identify problems before they reach senior management and drive them to resolution

\- Build SOPs, workflows, reporting systems, and accountability structures

Accounting \& Financial Oversight

\- Oversee accounting teams supporting the Vishram group of businesses

\- Review AP, AR, bank reconciliations, cash flow, expenses, and management reports

\- Monitor P\&L performance, unusual expenses, overdue receivables, and financial discrepancies

\- Ensure accounting information is accurate and delivered to management on time

\- Work with operations to identify cost savings and improve profitability

HR \& People Management

\- Manage the VMG HR Manager and ensure recruitment requirements are completed on time

\- Oversee attendance, productivity, performance management, onboarding, and employee accountability

\- Ensure department managers meet staffing and performance expectations

\- Develop a performance\-driven culture within the India office

Marketing Center of Excellence

\- Oversee the Marketing Manager and marketing team

\- Ensure marketing activities connect to measurable business results

\- Review campaign execution, social media, digital marketing, promotions, and reporting

\- Hold the marketing team accountable for deadlines, KPIs, and quality of execution

Technology \& Systems

\- Manage the Technology Manager and ensure reliable support for U.S. operations

\- Oversee business systems, user access, technology issues, automation, and process improvements

\- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive backend work and improve efficiency

\# What We're Looking For

Candidates should have experience from retail, supermarket, QSR, franchise, hospitality retail, or another multi\-location business, with an understanding of how different departments drive profitability together.

Relevant experience areas include:

\- Multi\-location retail/business operations

\- Team and department management

\- Accounting and P\&L oversight

\- AP/AR and financial reporting

\- HR and recruitment management

\- Marketing oversight

\- Business technology and systems

\- SOP and workflow development

\- KPI and performance management

\- Cost control and profitability improvement

This is not a coordinator or administrative position. We need a hands\-on business operator who can independently manage multiple departments, hold managers accountable, solve problems, and give U.S. leadership one clear point of accountability.

\# Success in This Role

You'll know you're succeeding when:

\- U.S. leadership doesn't need to follow up with multiple India departments

\- Accounting and management reports are accurate and on time

\- HR positions are filled and employee issues are handled promptly

\- Marketing projects are executed on schedule and measured against results

\- Technology issues are resolved quickly

\- Department managers are held accountable to KPIs

\- Processes become more organized, automated, and scalable

\- The Ahmedabad office operates as a true backend operations center for VMG's global businesses
